nodes.text: Hamlet also isn't a girl, but we don't really care about that, do we?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: I flipped the gender dynamics around to make a statement. It's `art.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I flipped the gender dynamics around to make a statement. It's [color=#3b78e2][i]art.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And I suppose that kiss you share with `Ophelio` in Act Three was added for `symbolism`?
nodes.text_bbcode: And I suppose that kiss you share with [color=#3b78e2][i]Ophelio[/i][/color] in Act Three was added for [color=#3b78e2][i]symbolism[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Exactly.
Taylor and $ZOE walk down the rows of seats to the stage where Hannah and Jenna are acting.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, theater club. This is $ZOE, your new Social Chair. She has an announcement.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm having a meeting this afternoon for the winter dance.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: A dance? That sounds marvelous!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Unless the dance is on the day of our play...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When's that?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: The first Friday in December.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll be able to work around that day. Do you guys want to come to the meeting after school?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Why, yes, of course! I'm envisioning something `artistic.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Why, yes, of course! I'm envisioning something [color=#3b78e2][i]artistic.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: With the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey guys, this is your new Social Chair, blah blah. She's putting on a planning meeting after school today.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: A planning meeting?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The winter semester dance. I'm calling it the Snow Ball.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Fun! I'm really excited for it. I want to make a big date of it for me and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awesome! So you'll come to the planning meeting?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Is that where you talk about decorations and stuff?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Isn't that what girls do?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey! There are no activities that 'girls' do. Boys can be just as involved.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: True, but some of us would rather focus on the practice. Our meet's in December.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's not on a Friday or Saturday is it?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It might be. We'll know more after school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's exactly why I need you guys there! I need to figure out the best date for everyone...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm not one to leave a girl in distress. And I'm sure Zach and Lee aren't either.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: We'll see what we can do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's all I ask.
$ZOE and Taylor head into the gym. $ZOE stops short when she sees Owen shooting around with Spencer and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's the matter with you? Go up to them.
Ben spots them first.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Look, it's our new Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: High five!
Spencer gives $ZOE a high five, and that relaxes her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey guys...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE has some news for you guys! It's her planning meeting for the Snow Ball. She's holding it after school today. You should come.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, that's my line.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Eh, we were getting there anyway. I'm tired of hearing you say it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That sounds awesome!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: But... We can't. Basketball practice. It's going to be killer. We've got a real shot at making it to Sectionals, so Coach is pushing us harder than ever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'll be sure to think of you when I plan everything out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Please do.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, let us know.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I think we're done for now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, there were a lot more cliques to talk to than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I know, right? You never notice when you're just in cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I didn't even know we had a `newspaper` until I become President!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't even know we had a [color=#3b78e2][i]newspaper[/i][/color] until I become President!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? But you've known Denni for a long time...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, but I always zone out when she's talking... It's always, like, blah blah blah, help the environment, recycle the whales. Boring.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Anyway, are you all ready for the meeting this afternoon? It sounds like every group has something going on during the Fridays and Saturdays in December.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All I need is five minutes to figure out the best day, and I'll be set!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good. The Vice President and I are going to be there to make sure you don't fall flat on your face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You and Justin? Great...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't mess up!
After school...
$ZOE runs into the cafeteria, carrying a large box full of snacks. Sam is sitting at a table, texting on her phone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm so late!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, you don't have to apologize to me. And you're not late. You still have a couple minutes before people start coming.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but I still have to set up all the food. Geez, today's been so busy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I talked to every group in school during the morning and at lunch... I haven't had five minutes to `think` about anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: I talked to every group in school during the morning and at lunch... I haven't had five minutes to [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] about anything.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't even figure out a good date for the Snow Ball yet...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll work it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
$ZOE starts setting out the snacks she's brought. Sam inspects them.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, yogurt `and` chocolate pudding cups? Sodas `and` juice? Fruit bowls and meatballs? The deli gave you a `lot` of food!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, yogurt [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] chocolate pudding cups? Sodas [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] juice? Fruit bowls and meatballs? The deli gave you a [color=#3b78e2][i]lot[/i][/color] of food!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. But I figure since it's my first meeting, it'll be okay. What do you think?
Sam swipes a soda and cracks it open.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not complaining...
Just then, the door opens, and people from all cliques start filing into the cafeteria, grabbing snacks and seats.
A few minutes later, $ZOE and Taylor stand in front of the group.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, guys! Listen up! $ZOE's talking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello! And welcome to the planning meeting for the Snow Ball. I'm so pleased that everyone could make it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The first thing I'd like to talk about are the dates for the ball.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A lot of you have concerns about what day it's going to be held on, but I promise you that we'll work it out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure that if we can cross out all the days that people are busy, we'll find a date that works.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So the first Friday in December is not good for the cheerleaders because of...

nodes.prompt: What are the cheerleaders doing on the first Friday in December?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What are the cheerleaders doing on the first Friday in December?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, that's exactly it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm not. I just want them to be able to go to the dance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Naturally. But sometimes that's not how it's going to work out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, it's not that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I mean, you `shouldn't` make too many promises... But more than that...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you [color=#3b78e2][i]shouldn't[/i][/color] make too many promises... But more than that...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you're going to stay in office for a while, you shouldn't favor one clique over another.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're a cheerleader. Naturally you want the cheerleaders to go to events. But sometimes that's not how it's going to work out.
Taylor leads $ZOE into the cafeteria, and $ZOE sees her friends on the cheerleading team laughing around a table.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So it's time we planned a cheerleading sleepover. Who's with me?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's that time of the year... We're going to be ranking which boys are the hottest.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ugh, count me out.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector's the best!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awww, babe... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have a new game we can play... Truth or make-out!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: So if you don't want to share your secrets, you can make-out with someone?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, me too!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I was talking about guys who `aren't` cheerleaders.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was talking about guys who [color=#3b78e2][i]aren't[/i][/color] cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Aww...
Taylor and $ZOE approach the table.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just showing $ZOE off as Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh yeah, congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So, you're totally going to let us plan the dances with you, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to let everyone plan the dances! I have a planning meeting after school today. You have to come!
$ZOE hands out her flyers.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay, paper! This is amazing! It's so glittery!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Amanda, I think she wants you to read the `words` on the poster...
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda, I think she wants you to read the [color=#3b78e2][i]words[/i][/color] on the poster...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh right...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're way interested in going to your meeting. I have some opinions on the dance theme.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! I'm really hoping to hammer down a good date that will work for everyone...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just don't schedule the dance on the `first Friday in December,` and you'll be fine.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just don't schedule the dance on the [color=#3b78e2][i]first Friday in December,[/i][/color] and you'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, why not then?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Remember Cheer Leader Days? They're workshops to help us improve our routines. The first one is on that Friday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot, I forgot. Okay, I swear I'll make it work. See you at the meeting!
Taylor and $ZOE walk away from the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You might want to be careful what you promise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you're a cheerleader, and you just swore to the other cheerleaders that you'd make their date work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you worried I'm...
Owen and $ZOE dash through the halls together, avoiding puddles, water balloons, and other students!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just up ahead!
Owen and $ZOE sprint a few more yards...
Owen darts to the right, opening a service door leading out of the school hallway...
And out into the school parking lot!
The door closes. In the ensuing quiet, they lean against the wall and catch their breath.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Thank goodness we made it out!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But it's not her last dance, and as much as I don't like it, she can just go with her friend, what's-her-face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. That one.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, before I make the announcement, can I just talk to her? She'll be pretty devastated.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. Go talk to Emily. Console her, tell her whatever you want. And then you're going to tell the whole school the dance is on that day `before` lunch ends!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Go talk to Emily. Console her, tell her whatever you want. And then you're going to tell the whole school the dance is on that day [color=#3b78e2][i]before[/i][/color] lunch ends!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why do I care about what Ben Kale wants?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because he has a girlfriend.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you said only 'five guys would be missing the dance', but that's not true. Those five guys `and` their girlfriends would be missing it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you said only 'five guys would be missing the dance', but that's not true. Those five guys [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] their girlfriends would be missing it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, you're kind of right.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you see why I can't schedule it on that day?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I see what you're getting at. You don't want to make more people miserable, especially your friend Emily Kessler.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why do I care about what Owen Harris wants?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because, uh, he'll be... He'll be sad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Awww... Boo hoo... Poor Owen...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! The dates work, $ZOE, and I'm not going to argue with you about it. Just do it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, if you can't do it for Owen, at least listen for Emily!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What does Emily have to do with all this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily and Ben want to go together. But if Ben's going to be gone, they can't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That sucks for Emily...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: But you're tramping on my civil liberties!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if we have the liberty to get into a fight...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Sure we do! And I want to exercise that right!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stand down, `Andronicus`, or I'll tell everyone in fourth period that the girl you have a crush on is named--
nodes.text_bbcode: Stand down, [color=#3b78e2][i]Andronicus[/i][/color], or I'll tell everyone in fourth period that the girl you have a crush on is named--

nodes.text: Andrew cuts her off.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Let's not get hasty! Civil liberties aside... I think we can reason this out.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah! No more fighting! Nerds, you're shaking out each and every one of those costumes!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Theater club, stop bullying them. If anyone starts any more fights, I'm revealing all your secrets at a school assembly!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like you have anything on me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I saw you in the computer lab with--

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Never mind! I got it, Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yes, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Ha ha, suckers!
Taylor turns to Jenna.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't think you're getting off so easily! The theater club still hasn't paid the administration its dues for the semester...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why don't you `figure out` where they are?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why don't you [color=#3b78e2][i]figure out[/i][/color] where they are?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Yes, Taylor...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And $ZOE! I need you to make a decision now, or else I'm going to make one `for` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: And $ZOE! I need you to make a decision now, or else I'm going to make one [color=#3b78e2][i]for[/i][/color] you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've got it, Taylor. I know the exact date I want to pick.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good! When is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The second Saturday in December.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You know what? I'm proud of you. When you said all that stuff about pleasing everyone, I was worried you wouldn't have it in you to plan over another group.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What group am I planning over?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, you didn't know? The basketball game is that Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, I take my compliment back. You made a mistake. Likely, you thought you were actually going to `make everyone happy...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, I take my compliment back. You made a mistake. Likely, you thought you were actually going to [color=#3b78e2][i]make everyone happy...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But the office just got field trip permission slips for the basketball team last period stating that they're going to be going away that weekend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does Owen know?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah. He's the one that turned the slips in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, I have to change the dance date... I can't put it on the day of the basketball game!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's the best day, $ZOE. It's the day I would have chosen if I was in your place.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Only, like, five guys would be missing the dance, and everyone else is happy! That date is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And you're going to make an announcement to that effect right now before I have to deal with anymore fights like this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, I can't...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about...
$ZOE goes to help Dex! Slowly and carefully, she extricates him from the thick fabric. Dex escapes!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Air, sweet air! I can breathe!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you could breathe under there.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I was trying not to move, so that I wouldn't loosen the itching powder too much.
He absently scratches at his arm.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Okay, some still got on me... At least it didn't get into my lungs, so thanks for that.
$ZOE stands up. Meanwhile, Taylor has shoved Jenna and Andrew away from each other.
When Jenna runs for Andrew again, Taylor neatly shoulder chucks her back.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad I went to help Dex... I don't want to be in the middle of that...
Taylor takes Andrew's collar and shoves him to the side.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Cool off!
$ZOE tries to help Taylor separate Andrew and Jenna.
She runs over, just as Taylor takes Andrew's collar pushing Jenna back straight into $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Whoa!
Jenna and $ZOE collide, and Jenna's elbow connects with $ZOE's nose!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhh!
Tears spring into $ZOE's eyes as her nose aches... They separate while $ZOE rubs her nose.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE! When I said 'help', I didn't mean 'act as Jenna's landing mat!` I meant, 'go help Dex'!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Honestly, he's like a stupid cat.
$ZOE turns to Dex, but he's wriggled his way out from under the dress. He sits there, coughing and scratching his back and arms furiously.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Cough. Cough. `Cough.` Great! Now `I'm` itching!
nodes.text_bbcode: Cough. Cough. [color=#e23b3b][i]Cough.[/i][/color] Great! Now [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] itching!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Ow, Taylor, what'd you pull me off for?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Do I seriously have to explain why getting into a shoving match with a girl is a bad thing?
$ZOE stands, dumbstruck as Taylor deftly pulls Andrew's collar to tug him out of the shoving match.
She's so rooted to the spot that she doesn't even react when Taylor shoves Jenna into her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I want to fix that starting now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What would someone who's your good friend do for you?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, you want to catch my next basketball game? We have an important one coming up soon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! That'd be perfect! I'd love to go!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I should probably warn you that it's an `away` game, so it's a couple hours away...
nodes.text_bbcode: I should probably warn you that it's an [color=#e23b3b][i]away[/i][/color] game, so it's a couple hours away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. I've taken a road trip with you before. It'll be fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Count me in. Get me a ticket!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! I can't believe I haven't been to one already. I'm such a terrible friend!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I have a feeling I'd do a lot better if you were watching.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, then I'd have somebody important to impress.
$ZOE blushes. She meets his eyes for a second, and she smiles at him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, I...
At that moment, the warning bell for classes rings!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We'd better head back inside. The halls are probably safe now that the teachers are walking to their classrooms.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you sure? It seems like the school is ready to tear itself to pieces.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You worry too much. It'll be okay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen. Good bye!
They part ways, and $ZOE heads towards her class.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh shoot! I didn't get the chance to talk to Taylor... I guess I'll have to do it at lunch...
A few hours later...
It's lunchtime!
$ZOE enters the hallway cautiously, wary for any signs of slushies or water balloons...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It `seems` safe enough...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]seems[/i][/color] safe enough...

nodes.text: And that's when she sees the nerds and the theater group converging like two hurricanes colliding!
Dex, Taylor, Ashley, and Andrew stop as Jenna and Hannah get in their faces.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Nerds! You've gone way too far!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jenna, what are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: During our dress rehearsal, we found `this` inside our dressing rooms!
nodes.text_bbcode: During our dress rehearsal, we found [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] inside our dressing rooms!

nodes.text: Jenna produces a bottle marked 'itching powder.'

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And then we found the powder over all the costumes!
Hannah angrily lifts one of the theater department's old-fashioned gowns. White itching powder falls to the ground.
Taylor looks from the dress to Dex and Andrew.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Please tell me you jokers had nothing to do with this.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Nope! I've never seen a bottle that size, shape, or color before in my life!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah right! This has 'Nerd Central' written all over it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Who` is responsible for pranking the theater group's `costume closet?`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Who[/i][/color] is responsible for pranking the theater group's [color=#3b78e2][i]costume closet?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Why do you automatically think it's us?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Because I `also` found this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] found this!

nodes.text: Jenna pulls out a 20-sided die from her pocket and throws it at Dex. It ricochets off his glasses and plinks to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Ah! Reflexes! Poor!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: `Whose` idea was this?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Whose[/i][/color] idea was this?!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Not ours!
Jenna steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: You're lying. Leave the acting to the actors!
Jenna pushes Andrew!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, wait!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You can't push us around!
Hannah throws the dress on Dex, and he falls backwards, tangling himself in the fabric!
Taylor looks around as if searching for an answer. She spots $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, this is your mess! Help me stop this!
$ZOE rushes over, assessing the situation...
She looks from Dex who appears to be trapped in the voluminous costume skirt and at Jenna and Andrew in a shoving match.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I've been so sad lately...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes it's hard to stop thinking about him...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just gets in the way of me being able to just be 'me' around people.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you get what that's like?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not really... I've... I've never really been in a bad breakup.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, sorry...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't be. It sounds... `Horrendous.` I don't think I'd want to be there.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't be. It sounds... [color=#e23b3b][i]Horrendous.[/i][/color] I don't think I'd want to be there.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And I'm sorry you had to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So that's what's been holding me back from being there for Sam to being there for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All this Social Chair stuff is hard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've practically blown up the school, and all I did was try to plan a dance!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's hard taking on a new job. You don't have to tell me that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I used to work in the summer for an ice cream stand. One summer, I got promoted from Ice Cream Scooper to Waffle Cone Waffler...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Were those seriously the titles you had?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll have you know that there was a lot of competition to be Waffle Cone Waffler... But the point is, I had no idea how to make waffle cones...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My first day, I couldn't make the cones right... There was a giant hole in the bottom.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All the customers who ordered one had ice cream dripping straight onto their shoes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We gave out so many free ice cream scoops because of the complaints... But eventually, I got the hang of making cones. You will too.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen! That does make me feel better...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's still a pretty bad excuse. I haven't been around for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, it's been...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's been pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Only 'pretty good'? I thought you were Owen Harris, sports champion of the world.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ha! I wish!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm not very good. Basketball doesn't come as naturally to me as football. I'm still learning.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm definitely not the MVP of the team. That would go to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ben? But he's... He's...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not really the athletic type?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, no.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's weird, but he is good. He's always passing the ball to the right person at the right time, and he makes the most ridiculous shots.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, I guess everyone has their surprises.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Do you have any surprise talents? Secret ones I should know about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not unless you count my `sick rap rhymes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Not unless you count my [color=#3b78e2][i]sick rap rhymes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, I can't wait...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { When you're waiting around for your morning ride... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Sometimes you find yourself with the urge to jive... {
$ZOE waves her hands around in a bizarre motion as if keeping in time to some unheard beat.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { But it's not cool to keep the dance alive... {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Keep it inside, keep it inside... {
Owen claps.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow, that was awful!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Did one of those words... `Actually` rhyme?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did one of those words... [color=#e23b3b][i]Actually[/i][/color] rhyme?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha! At least two!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about you? Any secret talents you've got up your sleeve?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can blow bubbles with my spit... Want a demonstration?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha, ew! No, that's all right... Ha ha.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's only a hit with the right crowd. Mainly middle school boys and my grandma.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... No, it isn't...
$ZOE and Owen laugh together for a few minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, Owen... I'm sorry we haven't been talking lately.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've just been so...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's right!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! I know I saw those posters for tryouts around!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's basketball going?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You really have been out of the loop, haven't you? I actually joined the 'basketball team'.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's right... I always confuse those 'B' sports!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So how's basketball going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Basketweaving?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They have that here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Er, maybe?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I would have been a goner if it wasn't for you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad we made it too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for saving me...
Owen drags $ZOE through the hallways, but her shoe slides on a puddle in the hall!
Her hands slips away from Owen's, and she topples backwards to the ground.
$ZOE quickly scrambles to her feet and looks around for Owen, but realizes she and Owen have been separated in the busy crowd!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen? Owen?!
Maria rushes by...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing? Run!
She passes $ZOE. $ZOE tries to follow her, but the other cheerleaders run by, clipping her on the shoulder and spinning her around!
$ZOE gets her bearings just in time to see two water balloons headed right for her face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahhhhhh!
$ZOE shuts her eyes and brings her hands up as water closes around her...
$ZOE has been soaked.
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

format.pattern: You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unless you want to be looking over your shoulder for flying slushies all the time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's not exactly happy with me at the moment... Because of the entire Snow Ball date disaster, I probably shouldn't talk to her until I know what day the dance is on.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you know now, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Kind of. I don't want to make the announcement until I talk to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I should stop by her office before class.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sounds like the right plan!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you nuts? And get everyone into trouble?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They practically are, Sam. All a teacher has to do is stick his head outside the door, and everyone's going to be in trouble!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, but... `You` don't want to be the one who gets blamed for ratting everyone else!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure, but... [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] don't want to be the one who gets blamed for ratting everyone else!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: These people are crazy! Do you remember that food fight?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, maybe having so many aggressive personalities mad at me isn't such a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should probably go to Taylor before going to the principal...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor's the head of the school. People have to listen to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It can't hurt. Taylor's never been one to stand dissension in her ranks!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And she's pretty good at putting people in their place. Back when I was a cheerleader, she told me once that if I fell one more time, she'd gnaw my legs off!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She has to know what to do!
Sam pulls $ZOE further down the hall, and they round the corner. To their relief, no one is right next to their lockers.
Sam opens her locker and starts putting her books inside.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, `that` was totally out of hand! What is wrong with everyone?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] was totally out of hand! What is wrong with everyone?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've got to do something about this and fast!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe I can talk to...
$ZOE freezes, her feet rooted to the spot!
Almost as if in slow motion, $ZOE sees the red slush splash all over her shoes and legs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eek! That's so cold!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And my shoes! They're ruined!
$ZOE angrily looks up, wondering if there'll be more. But Jenna's run off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, Slushie... It's going to get worse if we stay here...
Sam throws herself to the side while $ZOE dodges, narrowly avoiding getting her shoes stained by the drink!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yikes!
$ZOE steadies herself, wondering if there'll be more. But Jenna's run off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That was close! Come on!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What happened afterwards?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had to wait until everyone used up all the food and left. And then I helped the janitors clean everything up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, it was awful... I didn't know people would `riot` over me not figuring out the right date for the Snow Ball.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh, it was awful... I didn't know people would [color=#3b78e2][i]riot[/i][/color] over me not figuring out the right date for the Snow Ball.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... Did you pick out the date?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No. Every clique has some event on all the Fridays and Saturdays in December that I'd hold the dance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The cheerleaders and the theater club are busy on the first Friday, and the nerds have a convention on the first Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The journalism club and the guys in Auto Shop are busy on the second Friday, and then your swim meet's on the second Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey wait! I can help you with that... We just found out this morning that our match for Saturday was changed to the week before, so we `are` free that day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey wait! I can help you with that... We just found out this morning that our match for Saturday was changed to the week before, so we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] free that day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's amazing! I mean, I should check in with Taylor one last time to make sure... But if nothing else conflicts, that would be the day that works for everyone!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, I approve if it falls on a day I can go. Kimi's been talking my ear off about going to this dance all semester, and Ben and I really need a good date night.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's perfect. I could make an announcement about it and everything!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah... If you can calm everyone down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, hopefully, everyone's got the food fight out of their system by now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe today we can meet like normal, reasonable people!
Sam and $ZOE walk into the school...
Where utter chaos reigns!
At every corner, people are fighting!
Rebels threaten cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Outta the way, gel for brains!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You cannot insult my hair by describing my hair!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ugh, you guys are so selfish...
The journalism and theater clubs are at odds...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We know you guys are drama queens, but surely you can see why it's unfair if `we're` excluded from dances!
nodes.text_bbcode: We know you guys are drama queens, but surely you can see why it's unfair if [color=#3b78e2][i]we're[/i][/color] excluded from dances!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I don't know why you care anyway, Denni. It's not like you `like` them!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know why you care anyway, Denni. It's not like you [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] them!

nodes.speaker: Autumn
nodes.text: She likes them ironically!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't talk to `me` about irony!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't talk to [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] about irony!

nodes.text: And everyone beats up the nerds!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: If you guys weren't spending your days in nerdville, then everyone would get a chance to go to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Role-playing is not child's play. There are fake lives at stake! The happiness of imaginary people rests in my hands!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And that doesn't sound pathetic...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Nothing more pathetic than cheering for an archaic model that glorifies athleticism over academic pursuits!
Kenji stretches the hood of Dex's sweater over his head.
Elsewhere, Maria and Megan are having words.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: You're the worst!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ugh! What's your problem?

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: `You` are!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]You[/i][/color] are!

nodes.text: Sam, $ZOE, and Emily exchange glances as people start shoving one another and throwing things!
A book sails over Sam and $ZOE's head!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't think it's safe to walk down that hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We have to get to our lockers somehow...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Good luck, guys. The freshman lockers are this way, so... I'll see you later!
Emily walks in the opposite direction of the chaos to get to her locker.
$ZOE drags Sam down the hall. They make it about halfway before Jenna storms up to them. Her dress is stained, and she's carrying a cup of something red in hand...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-oh... She's trouble.

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Zoe! This is all your fault! I tried to get to school early to rehearse, and some mongrel tossed a `red slushie` at me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Zoe! This is all your fault! I tried to get to school early to rehearse, and some mongrel tossed a [color=#3b78e2][i]red slushie[/i][/color] at me!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: So I thought I'd return the favor!
Jenna throws a slushie at them!
$ZOE interjects before Sam can continue.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't figure out the best date for the Snow Ball, so there were some disagreements among the different cliques.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One thing led to another, and some food was thrown.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Gasp! Oh no!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But no one got hurt, and no one got in trouble, so it's fine.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's putting it mildly.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE totally dropped the ball on picking a good day to hold the Snow Ball, so everyone starting arguing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't `drop` the ball!
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]drop[/i][/color] the ball!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, either way, it got ugly real fast. There was a `huge` food fight!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, either way, it got ugly real fast. There was a [color=#3b78e2][i]huge[/i][/color] food fight!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People were throwing gobs of chocolate pudding, spraying soda, and launching meatballs left and right!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no! That sounds like a complete mess!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe it was a huge mess. I feel awful about it.
$ZOE chokes, letting Sam continue.

nodes.title: The Dance Dilemma, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Can $ZOE keep the school from tearing itself apart?

nodes.text: It's a new day at Twin Branches...
And $ZOE runs into Sam and Emily on her way to school.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, you two! How was swim practice?
Brutal. Coach K's insane now that the swim meet's less than a month away.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm used to training hard, but I swear, I can't move my right arm anymore.
Emily tries to stretch it out.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: OW. That's the last time I move today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How's it going with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That wonderful, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had a planning meeting for the dance yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it was pretty awful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Awful? What happened? The crepe paper didn't match the balloons?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not exactly. It's not as bad as Sam is painting it out to be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it was! You should have seen it...
$ZOE pats Emily on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm really sorry, Emily.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that you were really looking forward to the dance. But I couldn't find another day...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's okay. I know that you struggled to find the perfect date. It must be pretty hard for you...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, it was really hard.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So that's all you can do? There's no more moving it?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What's the point of being in power if you can't move anything?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I heard that you wanted to see Owen's game since you're such a good 'friend'.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But you may not be the only girl that Owen's encouraged.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You see, Paige and Owen kissed.
$ZOE feels her stomach wrench. She tries to collect herself.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: And Paige is going to be there, supporting him at the game. It might get awkward with the two of you there.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... See. Thanks for telling me that, Wes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Listen, I have some homework to do. I'll see you around...
$ZOE turns and tries to walk calmly away from Wes.
It's only after $ZOE turns the corner, away from Wes's prying eyes...
That she starts running home.
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 3: The Dance Dilemma, Part 2!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 3, Episode 3: The Dance Dilemma, Part 2![/b]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: There's a wise woman. It's not a bad thing to avoid gossip...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to have a cheerleader named Jessica who thrived on gossip.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't really like it myself.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: There's a difference between gossip that's hurtful and gossip that's true.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Though they're sometimes the same. Regretfully.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's this about Owen?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You really want to know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We `are` friends.
nodes.text_bbcode: We [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] friends.

nodes.text: Wes smiles widely.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I didn't realize the piece of information would be so interesting to you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Almost makes me regret my pricing structure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Never mind. So you and Owen are close.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, er... Well, he `is` my friend.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, er... Well, he [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] my friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what's the information?
There's a small silence after her announcement, and $ZOE's gaze darts to the basketball team who are all wearing sad looks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, guys... But this is the right call. Being Social Chair means I can't please everyone...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even if I'm disappointing those closest to me... At least everyone else will be happy.
All at once, the groups talk excitedly again.
Around $ZOE, she can see groups trading sheepish looks and apologetic grins.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Does everyone want to come to my house beforehand? We can paint our nails the same color!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll bring the paint swatches!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm so excited! I already have a dress!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: It's probably not as flattering as mine...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Looks like we're crashing another one of these shindigs...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Yep.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone looks so happy...
Spencer yells above the din.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, what about us? If you didn't know, we have a basketball game that day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I know. Taylor told me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... But that was the best day.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What? You've got to be kidding me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh nuts!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Aw, man!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm truly sorry, guys!
But Spencer and the rest of the basketball team have already gotten up and left.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot... I wanted to talk to Owen...
$ZOE tries to step off the lunch table to walk after the boys... But she's stopped by Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, Social Chair... Where do you think you're going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... I wanted to catch Owen...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'll have to do it later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that you've gotten the date out of the way, you can start planning the dance `theme` and everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now that you've gotten the date out of the way, you can start planning the dance [color=#3b78e2][i]theme[/i][/color] and everything!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey, everyone! Listen up! Your Social Chair wants your opinions on the dance!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Spaceships and aliens?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We were thinking it'd be marvelous to go with a Hollywood-themed dance...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, I suppose we're both thinking of `stars`...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I suppose we're both thinking of [color=#e23b3b][i]stars[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: Ha ha...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I don't care about the theme. Just as long as we play `Love is Like a Robot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care about the theme. Just as long as we play [color=#3b78e2][i]Love is Like a Robot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah, that's a great song!
$ZOE starts taking everyone's ideas, helping organize the dance.
But every once in a while, she sneaks a glance at the doors... Hoping Owen will come back.
After school, $ZOE darts from her classroom and runs towards the gym.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I have to let Owen know that I'm going to his basketball game instead of the dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope he still wants me there...
She's almost at the gym when Wes steps in her path and flashes her a smile.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Social Chair. Just the girl I wanted to see. Do you have a minute?
$ZOE halts to a stop, hoping it won't take more than a minute since basketball practice starts soon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Wes... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: First, I'd like to commend you on choosing a date for the Snow Ball.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We must all make some hard decisions. But you did well.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Which is why I've come to you. I'm in something of a bind.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You see... There are some `interested parties` that want you to know about something...
nodes.text_bbcode: You see... There are some [color=#e23b3b][i]interested parties[/i][/color] that want you to know about something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wes, what are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I have a piece of information that might intrigue you. About Owen.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But I'm not sure I should share it with you... What do you think is the best course of action?

options.label: Maybe you should keep it to yourself.
What is it? What about Owen?

nodes.text: $ZOE has failed!
Sometimes it's hard to disappoint people, but sometimes it's necessary for the greater good!
Try again and help $ZOE pick the right date!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The dance is on the first Friday in December!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, eat it, everyone who's not going to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! I'm getting my dance on!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just glad it's not on our day...
The cheerleaders and theater club stand up, outraged.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You know that's the day of our workshop!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `And` the day of our play!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] the day of our play!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How could you?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: You're the worst!
A couple weeks later, on the night of the dance...
$ZOE and a handful of other people stand around on a mostly empty dance floor...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Wow. Can we say lamest dance ever?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: If I'd known it was going to be this bad, I would have said, go ahead and schedule it on our convention day!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is `sad...`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]sad...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: `I'd` rather almost be role-playing than here...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'd[/i][/color] rather almost be role-playing than here...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys, I really am...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't realize that putting it on this day would ensure that half the school couldn't make it!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Look around, $ZOE. This isn't even `half`.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look around, $ZOE. This isn't even [color=#3b78e2][i]half[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, well, everyone else was going as someone else's date.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, it's not that bad...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, Em? It kind of is...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But it's not really your fault, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Actually, it pretty much is `only` $ZOE's fault... I hate to say it, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it pretty much is [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] $ZOE's fault... I hate to say it, but...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: $ZOE sucks?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: $ZOE sucks!
She hangs her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The dance is on the first Saturday in December!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Woo hoo!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE, go!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That sounds like the perfect day to me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just glad it's not on our day...
The nerds and swim team stand up, outraged.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing? That's the day of our swim meet!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah! We're swimming that day!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And that's the day of our convention!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: So the nerds may not be the most popular group on campus...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: But we thought `you` considered us to be important!
nodes.text_bbcode: But we thought [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] considered us to be important!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've forgotten the little people, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You're the worst!
A couple weeks later, on the night of the dance...
$ZOE and the other groups are dancing to a great song!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Great party, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah... Though I kind of wish Emily could have made it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Ben, I--
Suddenly the power cuts out!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay, now this is scary.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?
In the darkness, $ZOE feels someone tap her shoulder, and she screams!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hush up, will you? I figured it out. The nerds usually help us set up the lights and music for the dances...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But they were so angry with your decision that they cut everything early!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you happy?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is all your fault!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You suck! You totally suck!
Echoes of agreement waft towards $ZOE in the darkness, and she hangs her head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The dance is on the second Friday in December!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Yeah, eat it, everyone who's not going to the dance!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! I'm getting my dance on!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Go, $ZOE, go!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: That sounds like the perfect day to me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Woo hoo!
The journalism club and swim team stand up, outraged.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's the night of our showcase!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And the night of our race!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I always thought it was a stereotype that jocks and cheerleaders always got the perks in high school...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But now I `know` it's true!
nodes.text_bbcode: But now I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] it's true!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You're the worst, $ZOE!
It's the night of the dance, and $ZOE oversees the party...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So far, so good... Nothing's gone wrong.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, it's wonderful!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And it looks pretty good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Seems like things are quieter without the rebels around...
Suddenly, there's a commotion in the middle of the room. Flyers start shooting from all the vents, flooding the room with papers.
Students begin picking them up and reading them...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: '$ZOE isn't a natural brunette'?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: '$ZOE cheats on tests'?

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: '$ZOE is a drama queen'?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Why are all those lies about me?!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are they lies? I thought I smelled hair dye around you the other day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And do you really cheat? How does a `cheerleader` get good grades?
nodes.text_bbcode: And do you really cheat? How does a [color=#e23b3b][i]cheerleader[/i][/color] get good grades?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I study!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And these flyers... They're all lies!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But it's printed on official looking paper.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's journalism club and the rebels pulling a prank! You don't believe them do you?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, did you ever cheat?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe once, by accident... But that was like third grade!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Aha! So they are true!

nodes.speaker: Jenna
nodes.text: And if they're true, we have something to settle... There's only room for one drama queen in this school! And that's me!
Jenna flings herself at $ZOE, and the only thing that $ZOE thinks is that she definitely chose the wrong group to cross...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The dance is on the second Saturday in December!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's on... Uh... It's on... Well, I'm not sure...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Boo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys! I can't choose!
A wave of angry murmurs stirs through the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Seriously?! After all that, you're not going to say anything?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's `hard...`

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, life's hard.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're the worst, $ZOE!
A chant begins around the room.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: $ZOE's the worst!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: $ZOE's the worst!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: $ZOE's the worst!
$ZOE, frightened by the noise and regretting not choosing a date, flees the room...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am sorry this happened, Emily. Trust me, if I could change it, I would.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You seem just as upset over the dance date as I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I kind of promised Owen that I'd go to the game. But that was before I realized it was on the same day as the dance!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel pretty awful about it.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you have to go to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, I had been thinking that maybe I'd get my dad to drive me out to the game...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But then you remembered who your dad was.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yep. I have a match the next day, so no way is he driving me out of town.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean `you` can't go, $ZOE.
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't mean [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] can't go, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm the Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Which means all you have to do is set everything up and let it run by itself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm hanging out with you.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Correction... You are getting a makeover with us, and you are paying for dinner.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean you can't take off after you're done with that to go to the game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It... It might work!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Of course, you'd have to drive crazy far. And if you hang out with us until the dance, then you're probably only going to make it for the last quarter.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't care! Even if I have to drive `ten hours`, it'll be worth it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't care! Even if I have to drive [color=#3b78e2][i]ten hours[/i][/color], it'll be worth it!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Lucky for you, it's not that far...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is great! I can totally prove to Owen that I'm a true friend! And I'm going to keep my promise to him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for the awesome idea!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now I have to make an announcement.
In the cafeteria, $ZOE and Taylor stand on top of a lunch table, surveying the room.
The general unrest of the school has permeated to lunch, and even now, $ZOE can see spitballs and paper planes flying around the groups.
The students seem oblivious to $ZOE and Taylor, standing above the rest of them like giants.
Taylor cups her hands around her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is your Student Body President speaking! Everyone, shut up, or I'm canceling all your sports events!
The room quiets down immediately, and $ZOE begins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've decided on a date for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: After mulling it over, the best day for the dance is...
'The second Saturday' hangs on her lips, as $ZOE thinks of Owen and Emily...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The best day is the...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: A limo?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! The longest limo in the fleet! A stretch limo!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: A limo with just the two of us is like the loneliest limo in the universe! It'll look completely empty!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, maybe limos aren't the best...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I can at least buy you dinner...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dinner?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, you said you and Ben were going to go to some fancy romantic place...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Though I can't take you to the `Oceanside Obelisk`, at least I can definitely treat you to somewhere fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Though I can't take you to the [color=#3b78e2][i]Oceanside Obelisk[/i][/color], at least I can definitely treat you to somewhere fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, is there a restaurant Ben never wants to go to?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, he doesn't really like Japanese food...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then you do that! It's on me.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yay!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Does that sound better?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It sounds great.
$ZOE stands in place. Kimi shoots her an imploring look, while she puts an arm around Emily.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... It's really not a big deal...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? That's what you're going to tell her?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Actually, it `is` a big deal.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: At least apologize for ruining her entire freshman year experience!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry...
Emily takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, it's okay.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: But--
$ZOE finds Emily and Kimi in the bathroom, talking. Kimi is fixing her hair.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Emily... I wanted to talk to you about the dance.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Kimi and I are so excited!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I already have, like, the `perfect` ensemble. It's never too early to plan.
nodes.text_bbcode: I already have, like, the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] ensemble. It's never too early to plan.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She's totally not kidding. Kimi's the girl who planned her outfit for the first day of school three months in advance!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: First impressions! What am I always telling you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So, $ZOE, what do you want to tell us about the dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no... What's wrong? It's not on the day of the swim meet, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's on the second Saturday, the day of Ben's big basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! Ben doesn't have a basketball game that day... He would've told me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently, Owen just turned in the permission slips last period, so he probably doesn't know yet...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, no, no! This can't be happening!
The look on Emily's face is so serious, $ZOE doesn't know how to react!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do I do?

options: Say it's not a big deal!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: Ben expertly cuts all the choice pieces of meat off of the turkey!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well done, son. I can't understand why I never noticed how well you concentrate before!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I could take a wild guess...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Anyway, let's eat!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Awesome. I can't believe how much Emily's father's into me now that I'm a basketball star!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What have I gotten myself into?
Owen has failed.
