nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, okay! I'll help you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did I seriously just boss you around?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No... Well... Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where's your backbone?! Look, I need you to pretend that you're my boyfriend, but that isn't going to work if you don't have a spine, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I have a spine! Relax.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, I'll relax when I'm convinced that you understand how this works.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're supposed to be pretending that we love each other, and that means that we `act` like we hate each other.
nodes.text_bbcode: We're supposed to be pretending that we love each other, and that means that we [color=#3b78e2][i]act[/i][/color] like we hate each other.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you don't just `agree` to do what I ask you. Got it?
nodes.text_bbcode: So you don't just [color=#3b78e2][i]agree[/i][/color] to do what I ask you. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, it won't require very much acting.
There's an awkward silence between them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Not because I'm in love with you! Because you're annoying!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: OooooOOOOooo! You `looooove` me!
nodes.text_bbcode: OooooOOOOooo! You [color=#3b78e2][i]looooove[/i][/color] me!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh great...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hmmm... I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You just said I look sloppy. Besides, do rich people like you really need help from poor people like me? Isn't it the other way around?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you asking me for money?! I'm not going to `pay you` for friendship, Owen! That's really low, even for you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you asking me for money?! I'm not going to [color=#3b78e2][i]pay you[/i][/color] for friendship, Owen! That's really low, even for you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who said anything about money? Or is that all you think about from your ivory tower?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever! Fine! I don't need you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh... Then I guess I'll just be on my way.
Owen starts to walk away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait! Seriously, you cannot leave me here!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure I can!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do I have to do to get you to stay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hmmm... How about you... Say something nice about me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's it? You can have whatever you want, and your request is a compliment? You must `really` be lonely.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it? You can have whatever you want, and your request is a compliment? You must [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] be lonely.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, and every insult means you owe me `another` compliment. That's two.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, and every insult means you owe me [color=#e23b3b][i]another[/i][/color] compliment. That's two.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, fine. I'll get this out of the way quick since it's like impossible to say anything nice about you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Three.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grrr!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, fine! You're tall in a way that is appealing. You're nice... Most of the time. And you're... Um, ugh.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You kiss in a way that is not as gross as I expected. I mean, I didn't throw up in my mouth or anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Now will you help me?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess that's as close to nice as I can expect. Fine. I'll help.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Owen.
Paige leads Owen back into the house.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Paige, dear! This century! Tad has a polo match in the evening that he cannot budge!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, excuse us!
Paige grabs Owen, yanks him away from the table, and pulls him back outside!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I suppose that makes sense.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It does?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Obviously... She gets her eye for fashion from her mother!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You flirty kook! I wonder if it was one of my fashion ideas that got you this boy, Paige!
Paige speaks under her breath.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks. My mother ate that one up.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Care to tell me what the tofurkey is going on here?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ha! That can't be it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Don't get your mother wrong, dear. It's just that you don't possess a `classic beauty.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't get your mother wrong, dear. It's just that you don't possess a [color=#e23b3b][i]classic beauty.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: There's no doubt that the half of you that came from me is flawless.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: But your father's genes... What lunacy ever possessed me to accept that man's proposal?
Margot and Tad share a laugh. Paige speaks to Owen under her breath.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great call. I love being called ugly by my mother!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How was I supposed to know she'd actually be meaner than you?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't hear about any parties being thrown today. On Thanksgiving? That's really weird.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, it is really weird. Especially if you didn't hear anything about it.
Suddenly, the door swings open, and Paige is standing there, glaring at Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing?! You're late, `and` you're underdressed!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you doing?! You're late, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] you're underdressed!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who is that? Is that Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Hold on one second.

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: Paige, dear, is that your boyfriend at the door? Don't let him dawdle! The food is growing cold, and you know how I hate cold lamb!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who is that? Did she just call me your boyfriend?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?! Did Paige just say you're her boyfriend?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not what she said!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's going on?
Paige reaches out and grabs Owen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just shut up and get in here!
Owen shouts into his phone...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll tell you later!
He barely has time to hang up on $ZOE before he finds himself at an ornate dining room table setting, standing across from an older couple.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... I'm the `fourth` one at the party?
nodes.text_bbcode: So... I'm the [color=#e23b3b][i]fourth[/i][/color] one at the party?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ahem. Owen, this is my mother, Margot, and her boyfriend, Tad.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mother, Tad, this is my... My... Ugh. This is harder to say than I thought it would be!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is my `boyfriend,` Owen!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my [color=#3b78e2][i]boyfriend,[/i][/color] Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Ha! It's no wonder you can't say the word!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It isn't?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: No. From what your mother tells me, you've never had much luck with boys!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's true. She spends far too much time on makeup and very little effort on things that matter... Like accessories.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Your mother's jewels are what attracted me to her in the first place. Men are no better than fish. If it's shiny we move towards it.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh, I love it when you talk like that. You're so old and wise!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can accessorize just fine, mother. And besides, not all boys are attracted to shiny things.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: No? I suppose some might not be... So tell us, Owen. What attracted you to my daughter in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... You want to know about Paige's attractiveness?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There are so many things to say! And so many of them are amusing!
Paige stares wide-eyed at Owen, her eyes pleading...
Owen sighs.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But, obviously, I was attracted by her charming personali--
Paige gives Owen a sharp kick under the table!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No! Not that! Something else!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yup! Forgive me. What I meant to say was, I was attracted to Paige's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, why are you going into Paige's house?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: For the party? Paige is throwing a big Thanksgiving party. Everyone's invited.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Except for Spencer... And apparently, you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: A party? Like a family party?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, like a party thrown by one of our classmates.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Into what?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige's house.
All the pieces Ben slices off the turkey are very fatty!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... There's still a lot of meat left on the turkey.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's okay! You're probably just too focused on basketball!
Coach Kessler takes the carving knife back.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'll take over.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Where was my head? Not that it matters...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Now that I'm a basketball star, Coach Kessler thinks I'm awesome no matter what I do...
Coach Kessler is about to start carving the turkey when he catches himself.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What am I doing carving the turkey with a focused guy like Ben around?
He hands the carving knife to Ben and steps aside.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoa! Quite the honor, sir.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... I guess I just avoid the fatty areas and slice off all the meat!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, I was coming off a screen that Spencer set, and Erik was able to dish me the ball perfectly.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I caught it, but I knew there was like no time left on the clock!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: How did you know?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't know. Just instinct, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Instinct! Did you hear that, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I heard it.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I've been trying to hone Emily's instincts in the pool for years!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, anyway, instead of setting my feet, I just quickly turned and threw the ball up. It just happened to go in!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And he's still modest about it! It was a wonderful shot, son. Didn't you think so, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yup. Quite the shot.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I did want to talk about this lovely meal you've prepared for us, Mrs. Kessler!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, mom, this is delicious!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Kessler
nodes.text: Oh, why thank you!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks for the wonderful job on the meal, dear.
Coach Kessler gives Mrs. Kessler a kiss on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I guess we can hear the basketball highlights later...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See you before six tomorrow.
Paige marches off.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was strange... I wonder why Paige really wants me at her party!
You are now playing as Ben...
It's Thanksgiving Day!
Inside the Kessler house, Ben and Emily are sitting next to each other, waiting for Emily's parents to come out of the kitchen with the turkey.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It smells good!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know, I can't wait! I'm so excited that we're finally going to have some time together!
Ben takes Emily's hand...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Me too, Emily. I know basketball's been a wrench in our plans, but there's no more basketball today! Just Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No swimming either! Just Emily!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. Also, I'm hoping your father might ease up on me now that I'm, you know, 'committed to excellence'... Just a little.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: We'll see...
Just then, the kitchen door swings open and Coach Kessler comes out holding a plate with a huge turkey on it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: There he is! There's the man of the hour! What are you doing sitting way over there?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Anyone who can shoot the lights out like you deserves a spot at the head of the table!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Who are you? And what have you done with my father?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What?
Ben gets up from his seat next to Emily and moves to the spot at the head.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Remind me, son, how many points did you score in that first game against Piedmont High?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Twenty-five. But the other team wasn't very good.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I won't hear it! What a performance! Emily, how come you never told me your boyfriend was so committed to excellence?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know. I guess it slipped my mind.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: When you hit that three-pointer last week against Xavier High, what was going through your mind?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Do you think we could actually get some turkey this Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Easy, Emily. I'm just trying to understand the mindset of a champion. You should probably hear this too. Listening to Ben could be good for your swimming.
Ben sees the angry look on Emily's face.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, uh... We don't have to talk about the three-pointer. We can talk about something else.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Nonsense. Don't be modest, son. Athletes aren't paid gobs of money for their modesty!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh! I'm throwing a party!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Too much caviar?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! I just really need certain people to show up, and if they don't, the party will be ruined.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Am I one of those people?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, if it's that important, I'll try extra hard to be there.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cool.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you said it's a pajama party that starts at seven?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Owen! That's--
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh heh heh.
Paige punches Owen in the arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jerk!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ow! The jokes are not worth the pain!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Gross. Stop saying that because you're super wrong. I don't like you!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes, you do!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even though you think I'm a poor, low-class simpleton...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: { You want to kiss me! {

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm sorry, Paige. I'm not that kind of guy. Even if it would release all the tension you're feeling towards--
Paige slaps Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey! What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It certainly released some of the tension!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because it's going to be the best Thanksgiving... No dry turkey, no awful family, just music and shoes!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Shoes?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm having some of my attendants buy shoes for me. And yeah, I know this totally fits with me being some shallow, rich girl, but whatever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm willing to be a walking cliche if it means I'm walking in a perfect pair of heels.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm glad you've accepted who you are.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Anyway, it's going to be a big party, so it doesn't `really` matter whether you come or not.
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, it's going to be a big party, so it doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] matter whether you come or not.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, you'll come? Or okay, you understand that your presence is totally unimportant?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, I heard you! I'll need to check with my grandma to make sure that she's all right with it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So, if you do come, what time do you think you'll show up? The party starts at six.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Probably sometime around then.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I would feel a lot more comfortable if you came a little early... Just so I could brief you about protocol for this kind of party. Most of my guests will be `way` classier than you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I would feel a lot more comfortable if you came a little early... Just so I could brief you about protocol for this kind of party. Most of my guests will be [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] classier than you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So... You want me to be there early?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes. What are you going to wear?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Something nice?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. Just make sure whatever shirt you wear has a collar on it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You mean, like a t-shirt?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?! You can't be--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Relax. Relax. I'm just messing with you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh... Well, you can understand why I might take you seriously, considering what you're wearing now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you just tie some blue rags together for pants?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: These are jeans.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do poor people call rags 'jeans'? That's cute. So I'll see you in a `nice` shirt and `non-rag` pants `before` six?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do poor people call rags 'jeans'? That's cute. So I'll see you in a [color=#3b78e2][i]nice[/i][/color] shirt and [color=#3b78e2][i]non-rag[/i][/color] pants [color=#3b78e2][i]before[/i][/color] six?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you said you don't care if I go, but then you seem really concerned about when I show up and what I wear...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It sounds like...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ew! No!
A moment passes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, maybe. I mean, since you like me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I never said I liked you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well it's super obvious!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Let's check the log, shall we?
Owen pretends to unravel a scroll and reads from it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: On this day in history, Paige indeed declared that she 'has it crazy bad' for Owen Harris.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lies! Just come to the party, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh! You don't have anybody to spend Thanksgiving with. Or are you forgetting that your parents are separated?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for bringing that up! And are you forgetting about Grandma Betty?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like she counts! She's probably going to bingo night or church or something. You know, some old person gathering.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're out of touch with reality in so many ways.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Tell me I'm wrong!
Owen glares at Paige for a second.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay, fine! She's got a knitting group! But it's not an old person gathering!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha! You're so cute when you're wrong.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But she's only going to that `if` I decide not to have dinner with her. Her plan is to eat a Thanksgiving dinner with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's only going to that [color=#e23b3b][i]if[/i][/color] I decide not to have dinner with her. Her plan is to eat a Thanksgiving dinner with me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, if you want to have turkey scraps in a shack, I guess that's your right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It sounds better than eating caviar alone at your mansion!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, low blow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Big time...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I didn't mean it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I promise. Now tell me, why should I go to your party?
He smoothly lays the ball in!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Made it!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Good! That's how a layup should look! Now all of you... Get outta my face and go enjoy your holiday!
The players cheer as they rush off the court and into the locker room.
Later, in the locker room...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Can't wait to stuff a whole pepperoni pizza in my face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm pretty excited for my grandma's special Thanksgiving pumpkin pie!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Have fun by yourselves, dorks. I'll be spending Thanksgiving `with my girlfriend.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Have fun by yourselves, dorks. I'll be spending Thanksgiving [color=#e23b3b][i]with my girlfriend.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Speaking of ladies, that reminds me of one thing I am crazy thankful for!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: My man Owen has cured himself of Paige-itis!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's true! You haven't been making any absent-minded references to horses, high-fashion, or Paige's goddess-like body!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice try. I never said anything about her body...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Did I?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: It doesn't matter. You're your own man again, bro! Ever since you got that sweet pair of shoes like I told you to!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Yeah. You said buy some shoes, so that's what I did. I bought them. Definitely not a gift...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: And the moment you did was the moment you got that diva out of your system.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You know, she's not as bad as you think.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh huh. You're too nice, dude. Anyway, see you suckers later.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah, happy Thanksgiving, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You too. Later!
Owen is the last guy out of the locker room. The halls are empty due to the Thanksgiving holiday, except for a few people milling about...
...Including Paige, who is standing at her locker. Owen walks by.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Still here, huh? Forgot what commands to give your limo driver?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Har har. My last class ran late. Are you going to one of those soup kitchen thingies for Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. Unfortunately, I don't have much free time for volunteering.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who said anything about volunteering?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow. I walked into that one.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, you did. Anyway, I'm throwing a huge Thanksgiving party. If you wanna come, I guess you can.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's weird of you. Isn't everyone going to be spending time with their families on Thanksgiving?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh. But not everyone enjoys Thanksgiving... Or their families!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... Paige, are you inviting me because...
He trips over his own feet! The ball goes flying through the air and bounces off the gym wall!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That's it! A promise is a promise! We're going to run `all` day!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it! A promise is a promise! We're going to run [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] day!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're not serious, are you?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You bet your butt I am! Now get on that baseline!
Everyone stands on the baseline.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Go! Run! Run!
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Coach. `Huff huff.` We get it. Lesson learned.
nodes.text_bbcode: Coach. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff huff.[/i][/color] We get it. Lesson learned.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Lesson? This isn't a lesson! This is a punishment! Now run!
An hour later!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't feel any of my legs!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'm completely blind in one eye!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This is so stupid, Coach. Just let us go home!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I would... But Owen can't make a layup!
The guys groan!
Several hours later...
Grandma Betty shuffles her way into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Owie! There you are! I've been worried sick!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ma'am, this is a closed practice.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: Nonsense, I need to talk to my grandson.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What. `Huff!` What is it. `Huff!` Grandma?
nodes.text_bbcode: What. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff![/i][/color] What is it. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff![/i][/color] Grandma?

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: I just wanted to make sure you're okay, dear?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. `Huff!` Help. `Huff!` Torture.
nodes.text_bbcode: No. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff![/i][/color] Help. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff![/i][/color] Torture.

nodes.speaker: Grandma Betty
nodes.text: That's nice, sweetie. I'll be in bed by the time you get home. See you tomorrow.
Grandma Betty slowly shuffles her way out of the gym.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. `Huff!` Come. `Huff!` Back!
nodes.text_bbcode: No. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff![/i][/color] Come. [color=#e23b3b][i]Huff![/i][/color] Back!

nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I didn't even know you could airball a layup! Everybody run!
The players all groan as they run toward the far wall and back!

nodes.text: I've only got `one` eye, and I could do this blindfolded!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That doesn't even make sense!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Just make the stupid layup!
Coach hands Owen the ball again.

It's the day before Thanksgiving. In the gym, Owen and the rest of the basketball team are practicing. As Owen gets in line for another layup, he whispers to Ben and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why am I sweating this close to Thanksgiving? Shouldn't I be doing something a lot more American, like eating a deep-fried turkey wrapped in bacon stuffed inside a bigger turkey?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. Or getting a bunch of frozen pizzas lined up for the greatest sports marathon day ever?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We get it, Spencer. You have a huge man-crush on football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Football?! Pfft! I'm talking about wrestling, dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it that time of year again already?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know it. Surf 'N' Turf Murph is going up against not one, not two, but `all three` of Tres Samurai! They're the world's only katana-wielding mariachi band!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know it. Surf 'N' Turf Murph is going up against not one, not two, but [color=#e23b3b][i]all three[/i][/color] of Tres Samurai! They're the world's only katana-wielding mariachi band!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm `actually` kind of interested in seeing that.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] kind of interested in seeing that.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Cut the chatter! Or I'll run you so long, you'll give thanks for a glass of water!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, sir! Sorry, sir!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ericson! What's wrong with you? You weren't even talking!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I `was` listening! That makes me an accomplice to chatter!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] listening! That makes me an accomplice to chatter!

nodes.text: It's Ben's turn... He easily sinks his layup!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Smooth, Kale! That's what I like to see!
Owen is next in line for a layup...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You going to make this one, Harris? Or do I have to see yet another ugly layup?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's just a layup. Easy as pumpkin pie.
Owen takes the ball, dribbles toward the hoop, and leaps high into the air for his layup...
But the ball sails way over the hoop, ricocheting off the top of the backboard and landing on the other side, out of bounds!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That was the most hideous thing I've ever seen, even worse than my ex-wife after her fifth plastic surgery!
Owen returns to the back of the line.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You really suck, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One more thing to be thankful for.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up. What are you doing for Thanksgiving, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad's out of town again so I'm going to have dinner at the Kesslers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Again? They should start charging you for meals!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know how you can handle all that pressure.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, last time, Coach K called you a dumb party-loving dumbface.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not what he said. And you guys always know how to boost my spirits. Maybe you should try out for cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think anyone wants to see Spencer do a toe-touch.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about you, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just a quiet, relaxing dinner with my grandma.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Pipe down! One more peep, and I `will` keep you here through all of tomorrow, holiday or not! That means no turkey! No cranberry sauce! No pumpkin pie!

nodes.text: No! Not the pie! I swear I'll stop talking!

nodes.speaker: Coach

nodes.text: I get that you're trying really hard with my dad, and I appreciate that `so` much.

nodes.text: Look... I think Tad is going to propose to my mother tonight.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Tad? The guy we've been eating with. The guy with a stick up his--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. That guy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Lame.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When I found out last week, I just kept thinking about how I'd feel. What it would be like if he proposed. It made me ill.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And then I imagined hearing my mother say, 'Yes,' as though that guy is actually even half as good as my father is...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I couldn't bear it, Owen. I just couldn't.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's okay. You convinced me. I'm not going anywhere.
Tad returns to the room, followed almost immediately by Paige's mother.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Rosemary is deeply sorry for the meal. I realized that I was probably keeping her from her family, so I gave her the rest of the day off.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: After today's duck l'orange, you probably should have just fired her altogether. What an overcooked mess!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I just hope the day can be salvaged...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Perhaps I can help.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Margot, I haven't known you nearly as long as I'd like before something like this.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: But we're not getting any younger.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It is with my gravest sincerity that I inform you of my intention to marry you.
Tad pulls out a velvet box and opens it, revealing a ring with a massive diamond.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's so beautiful. Of course I'll marry you!
Paige's mother throws her arms around Tad. Owen looks to Paige and sees that she's crying.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Look how happy my Paige is for us!
Owen leans over and whispers to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it'll be okay.
Then he takes her hand underneath the table and holds it in his.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm here for you...
As Tad and her mother laugh delightedly, Paige gives Owen's hand a squeeze.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Correction. `Was` your phone. For the rest of this bus ride, this phone is mine. I'm taking it hostage!
nodes.text_bbcode: Correction. [color=#e23b3b][i]Was[/i][/color] your phone. For the rest of this bus ride, this phone is mine. I'm taking it hostage!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Seriously, though, I need it to text with my girlfriend.
Spencer adopts his nerdy, nasally accent.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ooh, I have to send my girlfriend a sideways smiley face! I'm brb in the afk so lol!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Have you ever texted anyone?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up, both of you! Ben, you're completely whipped, and Owen, you're dumb! Neither of you are focused--

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `Is` focused. Neither is singular.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Is[/i][/color] focused. Neither is singular.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey, Granny Glasses, either shut up or take a picture. This conversation is for basketball players only.
Nick very casually raises his camera and takes a picture of Spencer's angry face.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Anyway, neither of you `is` focused on what matters... The game!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, neither of you [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] focused on what matters... The game!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Willow Glen is one of the best teams in the state! They've got some Swedish freshman who's already being scouted by colleges!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: If we don't win this one, we'll `have` to win the next one in order to make it to Sectionals!
nodes.text_bbcode: If we don't win this one, we'll [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] to win the next one in order to make it to Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: So for the rest of this trip, we're going to get you focused.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How are you planning on doing that?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Easy!
Spencer gets into Ben and Owen's faces!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm going to ask you questions until all your puny mind can think about is basketball.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now how many points is a layup worth?
$ZOE thinks about the moment when Howard broke up with her at the Halloween Dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard... Are we... Are we ever going to see each other again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not for a while. But maybe someday.
Then he leans down and kisses her tenderly. She savors the moment as if it's their last kiss in the world...
She feels a tinge of sadness.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?
Emily snaps the picture.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That was good... Kind of.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh. I tried to think about when Howard left me... But I wasn't that sad! Is something wrong with me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, cuz. You probably aren't that sad about it because it was the second time you two broke up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That makes sense.
$ZOE closes her eyes and imagines what it would be like if Owen kissed Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're everything I've ever wanted, Paige. Way better than that Mary-Sue, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She can't even come to `one` of my basketball games.
nodes.text_bbcode: She can't even come to [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] of my basketball games.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Blah blah blah I'm rich! Now I'll say something mean that makes you like me! Now kiss me!
Owen leans down and tenderly kisses Paige!
$ZOE opens her eyes...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wow! You really turned on the emotion! I'm starting to tear up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! Now I am too!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Me three!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone stop crying! We don't want to smear our makeup!
The girls laugh at themselves as they dab at their eyes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Am I that jealous of Paige?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How jealous do you think the guys are going to be when they see how hot we look?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's only one way to find out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Picture time!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Make sure you get my good side!
The girls take turns having their picture taken. When it's $ZOE's turn, Emily's taking the pictures.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Okay, give me happy, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Perfect. Let me see a silly face. Like someone just threw water on you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gasp! I've been doused!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I like it! Now how about a sad one? Something to say, 'I'm so sad you're not here.'
$ZOE tries to make a sad face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sadder!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Like this?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No! Sadder!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is as sad as I can get right now, I'm having so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't even bother. When $ZOE's happy like this, it's impossible to bring her down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, I can do this! I just have to think of something really sad!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Like Howard going away?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Or somebody you like dating another girl?!
$ZOE tries to concentrate on something really sad... On...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fabulous? Why'd you say fabulous? Is something wrong with my makeup?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it looks great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But you didn't say great! You said fabulous!
Sam beelines her way back into the bathroom and slams the door!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong with fabulous?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe she thought you said something else, like... 'Fatulous?'

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's not it! Don't you know anything? Sam said that your dress looked fabulous first.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So, it looks like you chose the first word that came to mind rather than the negative one you actually thought.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? That's not what happened!
$ZOE knocks on the bathroom door!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Go away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, I didn't mean anything by it! You look like a knockout!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really! Get out here!
Sam steps out of the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry. I don't know why I freaked out like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It happens. I should have been paying more attention anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! We all look sensational in our own way, don't we?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can say that again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! We all look sensational in our own way, don't we?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can say that again!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Thanks! We all look sensational in our own way, don't we?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can say that again!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What about you almost punching Keith? Was that also to protect me?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: No, no... `That` was just a stupid mistake from a guy who was acting like a complete idiot.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, no... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was just a stupid mistake from a guy who was acting like a complete idiot.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't go too easy on yourself.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Seriously, I'm really sorry about what happened with Keith. I just got jealous.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: But ignoring that, we did have a pretty good time.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... We did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, I should probably get going. Was there something else you wanted to talk to me about?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yes...
Nate takes another big breath.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I want to take you to the winter dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow. Two seconds ago you were trying to get out of the doghouse. Now you're asking me to the dance?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Fortune favors the bold?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think so. Your time's up.
$ZOE gets into her car and shuts the door. Nate raps on the window with his knuckles, and $ZOE rolls it down.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Just listen... Please? When I met you, you were in a rough place because Howard left you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Now, once again you're hurt, and Howard's gone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I don't really have the same feelings for you...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You mean not the same feelings you have for Owen?
$ZOE slowly nods, surprised.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I get it. The heart wants what the heart wants. But you know who's going to be there for Owen today at his basketball game? `Paige.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I get it. The heart wants what the heart wants. But you know who's going to be there for Owen today at his basketball game? [color=#e23b3b][i]Paige.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She's gone to all of his games... I even heard she gave him his basketball shoes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yup. Doesn't it seem like they're already together?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've heard something to that effect...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So why waste your time on a guy who's not into you? Especially since the girl he `is` into is your rival?
nodes.text_bbcode: So why waste your time on a guy who's not into you? Especially since the girl he [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] into is your rival?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Is that the kind of guy you want? Or do you want a guy like me, who's always been there for you? Always thinking about you?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Even if sometimes I show it in the wrong ways...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not going to hurt you, $ZOE, I promise. And isn't that what you want?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll... I'll think about it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sure, I'll get my nicest outfit ready, just in case its good news. You know, $ZOE, nothing would make me happier.
$ZOE blushes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Bye, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Bye...
Nate walks away, leaving $ZOE stunned.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh, what am I gonna do?!
Later, the girls are getting their nails done at the salon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't do it, $ZOE. `Don't` go to the dance with Nate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't do it, $ZOE. [color=#3b78e2][i]Don't[/i][/color] go to the dance with Nate.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Would 'I don't like him' be satisfactory enough?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I might need a reason or two.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about three? He's not in the same league as Howard, he's overprotective in a way that worries me, and...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I don't like him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think 'I don't like him' qualifies as a reason for why you don't like him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it should.
$ZOE turns to Emily and Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you two think?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I like his hair. I'm out of the whole guy-ranking business, but if I were to give him a score, it would be pretty high.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I haven't really spent enough time with him to say anything that isn't superficial.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So superficially, he's cute!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Believe me, with him it's all surface.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's stop talking about Nate... Emily, how are you and Ben doing?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ugh. Don't even get me started.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is him playing basketball that big a deal?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Basketball's fine! It would be completely hypocritical of me to get on Ben's case for playing basketball when I'm swimming all the time!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Emphasis on 'all the time.'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The problem is my dad! Ever since Ben joined the team, my dad thinks he's the best thing since sliced turkey!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you... Want him to get along with your dad?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course! I want them to be able to be in the same room together, but I don't want them to be bff's!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, that sounds bad.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What's annoying is I've `told` Ben that he doesn't have to impress my dad so much, but he still does it!
nodes.text_bbcode: What's annoying is I've [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] Ben that he doesn't have to impress my dad so much, but he still does it!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think there's something else going on... But I'm not sure what it is.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it just me or is this too sad for a Girls' Night conversation?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, we're definitely going to have to step it up! We can still make this fun!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I promised Emily and Kimi I'd take them to dinner. Let's do that now and then we'll come back to Emily's place to get ready!
After dinner, back in Emily's room, the girls are trying on dresses, doing their hair, and putting on makeup!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily, you look `so` amazing!
nodes.text_bbcode: Emily, you look [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] amazing!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you serious? I `wish` I had your hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious? I [color=#3b78e2][i]wish[/i][/color] I had your hair!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sam, you're like a goddess in that dress!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I try, I try. $ZOE, where did you even find your dress! You look totally fabulous!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I got it on sale! But what about your makeup, Sam? You look...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was going on between me and Howard was between `us!` You shouldn't have done that, Nate!
nodes.text_bbcode: What was going on between me and Howard was between [color=#3b78e2][i]us![/i][/color] You shouldn't have done that, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Maybe I shouldn't have... But you two needed to break up, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So all I did was speed along what was going to happen eventually. Delaying it would have hurt more, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I care for you, $ZOE. You can see that, can't you?
$ZOE nods.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So you admit that sometimes it's good for others to take part in your life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um, well...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Think about it. All I did was speed along what was going to happen eventually. I helped you from getting hurt more down the road!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not--

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's the same reason I lied about the folder. For you, $ZOE!
Ben tries to run as fast as he can, but he trips over his own feet!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoop!
He sprawls on the pavement!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on, Ben!
Owen races ahead, catching up to the bus!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll be there!
Ben scrambles back to his feet!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hurry up, Ben!
Ben tries to take a shortcut through the parking lot! He leaps over the hood of a car...
But his foot catches and he falls in a heap on the concrete below.
Suddenly, he's at the game!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: How did I get here?
Around him his teammates are all different!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hey Ben, pass it to me. If you don't, you'll never be a real man!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't you love me, Ben? I'm right here, I'm wide open. Pass me the ball!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: I'm sorry I haven't been in your life much, Ben. But I don't like you hanging around Emily's father.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean Emily, right?

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: Why would I care if you spend time with Emily? She's great!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Why can't I spend time with Coach Kessler?!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Kale
nodes.text: He's not me, Ben. He'll never be me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben! Hurry up! Or we'll break up!
Ben tries to throw the ball to Emily, but it melts in his hands.
He starts running toward her to try and get her the ball but with every step on the court, she gets farther and farther away!
Ben isn't sure what any of it means, but by the time he regains consciousness, he'll be sure of one thing.
You are now playing as $ZOE...
As Owen and Ben hop on the bus in the distance, $ZOE, Emily, and Sam look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've got a dance in a couple of hours, and none of us have dates...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi and I are going to start our Girls' Night at the salon! You two should join us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll go get our nails done at this place near Emily's house. Emily, you can ride with me.
The girls laugh excitedly as they head toward their cars.
As $ZOE is about to reach hers, Nate comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, I have to go. I'm meeting up with the girls right now.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then I'll only ask for a minute of your time instead of the five I was hoping for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How considerate. I don't really want to talk to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I know I messed up with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Messed up? You almost punched Keith at Homecoming, you lied about what was in that manila folder with the bobcat on it, and you were the last one to talk to Howard before he broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you've done more than just mess up!
$ZOE opens her car door, and Nate steps aside.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't you think I deserve a chance to defend myself?
$ZOE stops herself from getting into her car. She turns to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Make it quick.
Nate takes a big, deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I lied about what the folder was. I knew that Owen was covering up how he'd put that kid in the hospital. I didn't trust him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I figured someone who runs from his problems wasn't someone you should be trusting either!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All he wanted was a clean slate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, maybe that's what I'm hoping for now...
This catches $ZOE off-guard.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And as for Howard, all I told him was what he needed to hear. That he was holding you back... That he couldn't be there for you...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Whoever thought it was funny to screech like bagpipes in a washing machine, don't ever do that again!
Coach yells at the guys from inside the bus!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Hurry up, Romeos! We're running out of daylight, and we've got a tip-off to make!
You are now playing as Ben...
Nearby, Ben and Emily are interrupted by Coach's yelling!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: And another thing!
$ZOE steps back from Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Excuse me, guys. I just wanted to do a dance for you to, um, inspire you tonight.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awesome! Let's see it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I love a good inspirational dance! That's what makes the chicken dance so popular!
The team's attention is now fully on $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Here we go!
$ZOE starts wiggling her hips and pumping her arms out in front of her furiously.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Woo! Go, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then I'll give you a little bit of this!
$ZOE starts sidestepping, her arms at right angles like a scarecrow.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Classic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And follow it up with this!
She crosses her arms in front of her at the wrist and pumps her feet, like a dizzy cowboy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Love it! Saw that on an internet clip the other day!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Done!
The guys all hoot and holler as $ZOE, out of breath, returns to Owen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know if that counts as an embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? I totally acted like a fool in front of everyone!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, but you're actually good at dancing, so you kind of pulled it off!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know if it counts as an embarrassment if you get applause when you're done.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Partial credit?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah, fine. You're officially a third of the way toward atonement...
$ZOE clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? You're actually going to sing, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You said that's the only way to make it count.
$ZOE clears her throat one more time...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { I hope that you guys win the gaaaaaame! {

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What is that noise?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { If you lost that would be super laaaaaame! {

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Is that coming from the bus?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I think it's coming from $ZOE! Shut up, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { But you wouldn't be the one to blaaaaame! {

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It feels like my teeth are disintegrating!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { So have no shame, have no shaaaaaaame! {
$ZOE blushes and tries to hide behind her hair as the players express their disgust.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, that was impressive and terrifying all at the same time.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Told you it was bad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Congratulations, you're a third of the way toward atonement!
The girls reach the bus.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm going to hang back for now. I'm not ready to talk to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's something you should do only when you're ready.
Emily goes to talk to Ben. $ZOE walks up to Owen as he loads his bag on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... What are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just wanted to wish you 'good luck' before your game.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I... I also wanted to tell you how sorry I am that I can't make it and, you know, how sorry I am about the dance being today. I feel really bad!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't worry about the dance. You were under a lot of pressure.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... I should worry about something else?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You promised you'd come to a game, and you haven't.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't just let you off the hook that easy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So... Well... Uh... Now I don't know what to do! I'm not used to someone rejecting my apology.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're just going to have to make it up to me. I think you should start with `an embarrassment.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just going to have to make it up to me. I think you should start with [color=#e23b3b][i]an embarrassment.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My grandma always says a broken promise can be mended with an embarrassment, a gift, and a confession.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Since we're out here in public, this would be a great time for an embarrassment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're serious?
Owen tries to form as serious a face as possible.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. What do I have to do?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I am `so` glad you asked. I think since tonight's the dance you should definitely do a silly dance or sing a silly song!
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] glad you asked. I think since tonight's the dance you should definitely do a silly dance or sing a silly song!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right now? In front of the basketball team?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right now!
$ZOE takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I'll definitely pick dance. I'm such a horrible singer! Like, when I sing, cats die.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It can't be that bad. You didn't seem fazed the other day when you rapped.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Rapping and singing are completely different! Trust me, it's `that` bad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Rapping and singing are completely different! Trust me, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Okay. Okay. But you should know... The more embarrassing the act, the easier it is to mend the promise. It's up to you...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's there to talk about? He cheated on me, I threw hot chocolate at him, he apologized. I think that counts as a win in the breakup handbook!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Wait... Did you ever talk to him after the car accident?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: A little. We've talked a couple of times at parties. About photography and football, of all things.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I meant, `about` Sara.
nodes.text_bbcode: I meant, [color=#3b78e2][i]about[/i][/color] Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... You think I should?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: At the very least it might make both of you feel better.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It'll be good for you, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's it? You don't have any ulterior motive?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! I swear!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because guys and girls can't really `be` friends! It always gets romantic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Because guys and girls can't really [color=#3b78e2][i]be[/i][/color] friends! It always gets romantic!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So you can see how this seems like a setup!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think that's true!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Setting people up means putting them together and saying, 'Sam, this is Nick. She thinks you're cute. Nick, this is Sam...'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: 'He wants to have a bunch of little Nicklets with you!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, I couldn't resist!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ew! I just pictured a bunch of babies wearing Nick's hipster glasses.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's definitely `not` where I was going...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] where I was going...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Back me up, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, it sounds like you're trying to fix your cousin up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sigh. Fine. Don't believe me.

nodes.title: What's there to talk about? He cheated on me, I threw hot chocolate at him, he apologized. I think that counts as a win in the breakup handbook!

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE...
It's the second Saturday in December, the day of the winter dance and also the day of the basketball team's big away game!
$ZOE, Sam, and Emily are headed toward the basketball team's bus to see the team off!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for coming, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `was` looking forward to a zombie movie before the dance tonight...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] looking forward to a zombie movie before the dance tonight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I still don't understand why you needed me to tag along so bad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because zombies can wait! They're slow-moving, and the team needs as much support as it can get!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh-huh, support. Because this has nothing to do with how guilty you're feeling after scheduling the dance on the same day as the game?
$ZOE's eyes dart across to Emily.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's okay, $ZOE. I know you had a hard choice to make. Scheduling the dance today upset the fewest people.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm surprised you're not going to the game to support Owen. Wasn't that the plan?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Something came up between us. I'd... I'd rather not talk about it if that's okay.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine by me. I still don't understand how having `one` extra person around to support the team is going to mean anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine by me. I still don't understand how having [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] extra person around to support the team is going to mean anything.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Especially if that person's me. I don't really do `cheery` anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Especially if that person's me. I don't really do [color=#3b78e2][i]cheery[/i][/color] anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, maybe I didn't ask you to come `just` for support.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe I didn't ask you to come [color=#3b78e2][i]just[/i][/color] for support.

nodes.text: $ZOE nods at the bus. Nick is there, loading camera equipment on. Sam stops in her tracks.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nope!
She immediately turns around, but $ZOE stops her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, wait! It's not what you think!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? Because it looks like you're trying to set me up with my ex-boyfriend, who cheated on me with Sara--
Sam stops talking.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Emily.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's okay. I know that you, Nick, and Sara had some history. To be honest, I think you two would be really cute together!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. Couldn't you at least `pretend` to be more upset?! I really don't want Perky Gumdrops here meddling with my life.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. Couldn't you at least [color=#3b78e2][i]pretend[/i][/color] to be more upset?! I really don't want Perky Gumdrops here meddling with my life.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam! Can't help you there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, I'm not trying to set you up! I just think you two...
Will $ZOE bring a date to the winter dance?
Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, what made you decide to call him now?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because of what Emily said about her and Ben. They're too busy to spend any time together. She has a great guy, but he's not around.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So if I have a chance to be with a great guy who's `actually` going to be around, don't I owe it to myself to give him a chance?
nodes.text_bbcode: So if I have a chance to be with a great guy who's [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] going to be around, don't I owe it to myself to give him a chance?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I `guess` I see your point.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]guess[/i][/color] I see your point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And for what it's worth, I'm `not` going to just fall for Nate. I'm not an idiot.
nodes.text_bbcode: And for what it's worth, I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to just fall for Nate. I'm not an idiot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know. Fine. Call him. But if he harms one hair on your perky head, I will get very medieval on him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean, like throw him a fancy tea party?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? No! It means I'm going to--

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm kidding, Sam. Just wanted to see how naive you thought I was...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You got me. I'm going to go help Emily with her hair.
Sam heads back to the room. $ZOE takes a deep breath and calls Nate...
That night, Nate meets $ZOE, Sam, Emily, and Kimi just outside the dance.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE. A rose for a rose.
He hands her a single red rose.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's really sweet of you, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All the good ones are taken!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh brother.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE mentioned that you guys are going stag to the dance, so if it's not too forward...
Nate hands Emily, Kimi, and Sam their own roses as well.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Too nice!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, Nate!
$ZOE nudges Sam with her elbow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: See?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll give credit where it's due. That was smooth.
As they get closer to the dance, Nate holds $ZOE back.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Girls, if you don't mind, I'd like a word with $ZOE alone?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Sure. We'll be inside.
Sam looks at $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Medieval.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Medieval.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: The girls step inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: We're about to go to the dance together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It does seem that way, yes.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: The last time we went to a dance, we went as friends.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's true.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm not going to this one as a friend, $ZOE.
$ZOE blushes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Good.
Nate holds out his arm for $ZOE, and the two of them walk together into the dance.
What will happen to the girls at the dance? Find out in next week's episode of Surviving High School!
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 5: Snow Ball, Part 1!`
