nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Honestly, Sam, if I hold every guy to Howard's level I'm just going to end up becoming an old cat lady!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you even think the Howard I grew to love could compare with the Howard I first met?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And that's not confusing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The point is that if Howard can't even compete with Howard, it isn't fair to try to compare other guys to him!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I guess that's true.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you agree.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what about how overprotective Nate is? I mean, he almost punched Keith at Homecoming!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, and that's not excusable, but he `does` feel really bad about that...
nodes.text_bbcode: I know, and that's not excusable, but he [color=#3b78e2][i]does[/i][/color] feel really bad about that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let's give him a medal then.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So when he almost punched Keith at Homecoming just because Keith was talking to you... That was okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, of course not!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Then how isn't that a valid argument?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because yeah, he overreacted, but that was `one` time! He felt really bad about it, apologized, and hasn't done anything like that since.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because yeah, he overreacted, but that was [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] time! He felt really bad about it, apologized, and hasn't done anything like that since.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That you know of! Howard would never have done something like that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Nate's not Howard! Howard also lied to me about why he was back!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you saying? You'd rather be with Nate than Howard?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... No. I'm just saying that Howard wasn't perfect either.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I just wish Ben and I didn't have such busy schedules. I never realized how good I had it back when Ben could hang out with me whenever I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Being with a great guy is wonderful... But being with a great guy and both of you having time to spend together... `That` is the dream.
nodes.text_bbcode: Being with a great guy is wonderful... But being with a great guy and both of you having time to spend together... [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] is the dream.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think I'll settle for no guy and doing whatever I want!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's joking, right? Whatever guy I end up with, I hope he's not a loser!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There is something to be said for a guy who's around... A guy who's there for you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... I'll be right back. I need to make a phone call.
In the dining room, $ZOE is trying to find Nate's number in her Contacts list when Sam comes out, her arms crossed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you calling Nate?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why did you ask for my opinion about him if it doesn't mean anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your opinion means a lot to me, Sam!
$ZOE finds Nate's name, but she doesn't press the call button.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I get that you don't like him, but I don't think you have valid enough reasons to convince me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So... Him not being in Howard's league... Or being way overprotective...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which one of those isn't valid?

nodes.prompt: Which reason of Sam's isn't valid?

options.label: Nate not being in Howard's league.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which reason of Sam's isn't valid?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think she said 'Ben looks so Paige'?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you saying Ben looks like a girl?
Emily looks at the picture again.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess in the right light...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, that's not what I meant. Just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're so lucky to have someone like Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: You have a funny way of saying it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I was distracted!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah, who knew, right? All this time I thought he was just a really smart guy who liked to goof around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like discovering that your boyfriend is actually a superhero.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well... A lesser superhero... Jumpshot Man?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're really lucky to have someone like Ben.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I guess I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is something wrong?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Uh what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What Paige!
Owen follows. He jumps up for his layup and releases the ball early, sending it high into the air, completely over the backboard!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What are you doing?!
It's Ben's turn next! He dribbles twice and tries to grab the ball...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily...
But he's completely distracted! He fumbles the ball and it flies off his leg and into the snack shack!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You guys have no focus! Worse, you're ruining my post-game nacho-bration!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You'd better figure out what's wrong quick!
Later, the team is warming up before the start of the game...
Ben hands his phone to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think you could take some pics for me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Lay up drill! Let's go!
Spencer goes first, easily laying the ball into the hoop.
Just when the team reaches the bus, Ben send his text message! A second later, his battery dies!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Did you get it off in time?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hopefully, Emily will understand what I sent!
Just when the team reaches the bus, Ben tries to press the 'send' key... But his phone shuts off!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Why did I use such long words?!
Just when the team reaches the bus, Ben sends his text message! A second later, his battery dies!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Did you get it off in time?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think so...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I'm not sure it made much sense...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, is that right?
Ben types in 'soup!'

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I must be hungry! Too late to change it!
Ben's low battery warning pops up onto his phone. He closes it and types out the last word of his text.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Soon!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait... Is that it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That can't be right... Is it?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think that's it!
Erik stumbles, falling forward! Ben catches him!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oof! Thanks! You're my hero!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't mention that. Ever.
He returns to texting!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What's the next word?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why did I use so many 'e's?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, wait a minute. I could have short-handed that to save time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I think that's enough!
A car brakes hard in the lot, nearly hitting Andy!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Can't you see?! I'm running here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Next word! 'Be'!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My battery's going to die at any moment! I don't have time to type out every letter in the phrase!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good so far!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that clear enough?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Okay... Next word!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Look out! Shrubbery!
Ben leaps over a bush!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Where was that athleticism before?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Next word! 'Over'!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I spell out every word, my battery's going to die before I can send the text!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Don't need to write out the whole word!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is that clear enough?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: In conclusion, I haven't been embarrassed like that in years! I'm disappointed in all of you!
Later...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: A squared plus B squared equals C squared?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It sounded better in my head...

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: They must not have a very good teacher to student ratio at your school!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You take that back!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Nah, I think I'll just beat you instead!
Lars starts to drive hard to the hoop, right past Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No way!
Ben overcompensates his speed! Lars suddenly stops, and Ben goes flying past him!
Lars easily makes a wide-open bank shot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Crap!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Meaning?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Meaning you suck, and your face is ugly!
Lars is visibly affected, fumbling the ball off his foot!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Whoops!
It rolls off of Ben's leg, heading toward the out of bounds line!
Before it crosses the line, Owen dives on it and calls a timeout!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great hustle, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just showing some heart!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like... Like... Like something really bad.
As the game winds down, Willow Glen's lead has dwindled down to eight points.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ericson! Get in there! Andy only needs to rest for a minute, so keep it to just two or three mistakes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You got it, Coach! I'm only going to make one mistake at most!
Lars gets the ball, still with a lot of energy in his steps!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm so tired... The only way I can beat him is to psych him out!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: You must feel like the first law of thermodynamics... You can't win!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you must feel like...
Ben aims for the ball, but Lars gets the shot off clean!
Lars sinks the shot!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What happened to stopping him, Kale?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying!
Lars can't see the hoop when he shoots!
He misses his shot off the front of the rim, and Spencer's there for the rebound!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This ball is mine! I own it like I own your faces!
Spencer gives the ball to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice D, Kale!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!
Ben aims for a middle area between the ball and Lars's eyes!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gotcha!
Lars instinctively goes up for a shot, just as Ben collides with Lars's body!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Oop!
The whistle blows, and the ref calls Ben for a foul. Lars is awarded two free throws.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Don't reach in like that, Kale! We can't afford you fouling out!
Lars sinks both shots. Jacob brings the ball up for Twin Branches...
He passes it to Andy, who shoots a long jump shot... And completely misses the hoop!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whoops!
Ben just stands there and watches as Lars nails a jump shot in his face!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! Are you playing zombie defense?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be sorry! Snap out of it and do something!
Ben inbounds the ball to Andy, who dribbles all the way downcourt for a long jump shot... And completely misses the hoop!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whoops!
Back comes Willow Glen, their point guard handling the ball across the half-court line...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Lars gets the ball, I'm going to let him think he's open, but then I'll disrupt his vision!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Newton's Law of Motion... I'm in motion, and I'm going to keep on moving right past you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unless the object is acted on by another force... In this case, me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha! Scienced!
Lars catches a pass from the point guard. Ben sets his trap, giving Lars a little bit of space...
Lars takes the bait, picking up his dribble and lining up his shot!
Ben reaches out, trying to block...
Ben hesitates for a moment, then decides to go for the ball!
Ben reaches in to strip the ball from Lars!
Ben hesitates for a moment, then decides to go for the ball!
Ben strips the ball out of Lars's hands! He passes it off to Andy, who dribbles down and sinks a fifteen-foot jump shot!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: With my eye closed!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha! Nice shot, Andy!
Ben stays patient, holding his ground.
Then Lars picks up the ball!
Ben reaches in to strip the ball from Lars!
Ben waits, holding his position as Lars keeps dribbling...
Willow Glen comes back, getting the ball in Lars's hands again. Ben gets into his defensive stance in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: My game is like space, always expanding!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My defense is like a black hole, nothing escapes it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This time, I'll let him go right... The second he picks up the ball, I'll strip it from him!
Lars jukes to the right, but keeps dribbling...
Ben forces Lars to his offhand, his left!
Lars pulls up for a quick shot, but Ben is there to block it!
Jacob scoops up the ball... And dribbles by his man for an easy score!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ask and you shall receive!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I had known it was that easy, I would have asked for more!
Lars drives to his right, past Ben, and scores an easy bucket!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why did I let him go that way?
On the next play down, Jacob tries to drive by his man, but the ball gets stolen from him!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Grr!
Ben's feet slip!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh-oh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And it's never hard to convince the heart to go after what it already wants...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: At least that's what I learned from the last rom-com I saw! In the final scene, the romantic leads got married and everyone danced! What a twist!
The ref comes over to the guys and tells them to hurry up. They break apart. Spencer pulls Ben aside.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What about you, Kale? What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben

Ben's eyes drift to the crowd, searching, looking for Emily... Then sadly back to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Ben

The ref blows his whistle, and the guys step onto the court. Nearby, Paige and her friends are sitting courtside!

Willow Glen takes the ball out, and their point guard immediately gets the ball to Lars.

nodes.speaker: Ben

It's the start of the second half of Twin Branches' big basketball game against Willow Glen!
Before the game resumes, Ben brings the team in for a quick huddle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're down by seventeen points, guys. It doesn't look good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we don't win this one, we'll have to win our last game to make Sectionals.

nodes.speaker: Spencer

nodes.speaker: Ben

nodes.text: And in 'A Christmas Curse', play a special holiday episode, featuring $CADY from `Magic School!`

nodes.text: Denni turns to the two men.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: So you two don't agree on the method... But the intent is the same.
Mal and Mitch trade looks. Then Mitch sighs.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Look, Mal, maybe we can agree to disagree. You heard something, and you didn't hesitate to confront danger for everyone else.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I can respect that at least.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: I'm sorry I mistook you for a thief. Maybe the job does make me a little twitchy. But I do honestly believe I help people more than I harm them.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I understand.
They shake hands.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: So tell me one thing... Why are you even dressed as Santa in the first place? Maddie's asleep.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I was going to visit her as Santa to give her a doll she said she'd wanted. I might do that before we go to bed.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Not to mention that there's a gingerbread cookie she's set out with my name on it.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Santa's privileges.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Well, now that that's over. Let's head to bed.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Good night, everyone!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Night!
It's Christmas morning!
The household awakens to the delightful sounds of Christmas carols and...

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Hey! Hey, everyone! Santa came! He really came, and he gave me a doll!
Maddie runs downstairs into the living room to find everyone else grabbing plates for breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Colt, did you see my doll?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I definitely heard about it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Santa dropped by, huh?

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: He did! He really did! I dreamed about him giving me a gift last night, and I thought it was a dream, but it was really him! The doll was here when I woke up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's wonderful!

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: Is everyone else ready for presents?
And for the next hour, everyone hands out gifts and cards, laughing merrily and sipping apple cider.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks, Mal and Natara for the photos... And thanks, Mom, for the camera lens! This is so amazing!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Yeah, Mom, thanks for my gift too. The poetry workshop you got for me is going to make my art so much better.

nodes.speaker: Cynthia
nodes.text: I know my daughters.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey Denni, I got something for you...
Denni opens a small box where a metallic pendant sits attached to a sleek black ribbon.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt... This is beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: It's a pendant made from the motorcycle I wrecked when we were in that helicopter chase.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: ...In a video game?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee... Thank you.
And over on the other side of the tree...

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Mal, Natara... Here are gifts for you.
Mal and Natara unwrap their gifts.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: An apron?

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Yes, cooking together is sign of true love. Don't worry, I got Mal something else to match...
Mal pulls out another frilly matching apron.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: You shouldn't have.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Don't wear them out.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: We got something for you too, Mitch.
Natara plucks a package out from underneath the tree, extending it to Mitch.
Mitch opens it to reveal a reindeer sweater. He turns it over... And smiles.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: It's great.
He says it with such genuine gratitude that Mal is stunned.

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Yes. Reindeer sweaters, crackling fires in the fireplace, families by the Christmas tree... It all says Christmas to him.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Right on the money, as usual.
Suddenly, Mitch stands up.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Everyone, over here... I'd like to make a toast.

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Oh dear.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: Christmas is about being around people you love. And this Christmas, we are lucky to have so many people around.

nodes.speaker: Mitch
nodes.text: I just want to say thank you for being in Cynthia's life... And also my own. We hope we see you all again next year.

nodes.speaker: Natara
nodes.text: Hear hear.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Merry Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Madeline
nodes.text: Merry Christmas, everyone!
