nodes.text: Cute boots... Strappy sandals... This is so grown up!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You know, it sounds a lot less grown up when you call it grown up.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Oh, yeah. Right.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You guys don't need to be in `too` much of a rush to grow up.
nodes.text_bbcode: You guys don't need to be in [color=#e23b3b][i]too[/i][/color] much of a rush to grow up.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Hah. Adults always say that. Kel, look at these ballet flats!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So cute!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Great! Let's get them!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... `Lots` of shoes are cute. But that doesn't mean we know what we want yet.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Howard... [color=#3b78e2][i]Lots[/i][/color] of shoes are cute. But that doesn't mean we know what we want yet.

nodes.text: And so, an hour later...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Okay, I think we've got the boots that we want!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Finally!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Well, you'll like this part... These shoes are on sale.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nice!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Hmph. You got lucky.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... I know it's been really tough... You and $ZOE were so close, it's natural for it to take a while for you to get over all that happened.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, please. Howard's not even `trying` to get over her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, please. Howard's not even [color=#3b78e2][i]trying[/i][/color] to get over her.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Seriously. All he's done since he's been home is mope and mope.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Girls, be nice to your brother. You don't know what he's going through.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Now, Cathy, the girls have a point. Howard should be getting out of the house, having some fun, breaking a few laws...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Horace...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Not `big` laws. Just getting into a little trouble! It's what kids do! Here, son... Take my car today.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not [color=#e23b3b][i]big[/i][/color] laws. Just getting into a little trouble! It's what kids do! Here, son... Take my car today.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Go to the mall, or a bowling alley, or a chat room. Wherever kids your age go these days.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can go to the mall... But you know a chat room isn't actually a room, right?

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: A chat room's not a room? What is `wrong` with this generation? Back in my day, you didn't call it a room unless it had four walls and a ceiling!
nodes.text_bbcode: A chat room's not a room? What is [color=#e23b3b][i]wrong[/i][/color] with this generation? Back in my day, you didn't call it a room unless it had four walls and a ceiling!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: If Howard's going to the mall, can we go with him?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah, can we?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That would actually give me some time to finish wrapping presents... Howard, would you mind?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, they can come.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Aw, how sweet! My kids, all going to the mall together. Have fun, and don't be out too late!
And so, twenty minutes later, Howard and the twins are at the mall...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't get it, twins. I've been back for almost a whole week, and you two haven't tried to pull a single prank on me.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No wild animals in my bed, no hot sauce on my food... Not even a single leaf of poison ivy in my sock drawer.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just tell me now, are you planning something truly horrible?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know Mom and Dad said you'd be sent to military school if you do anything involving fire and gasoline again.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Please, Howard, we're `so` over pranks.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, Howard, we're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] over pranks.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yeah. We're not `children` anymore.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. We're not [color=#3b78e2][i]children[/i][/color] anymore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are you talking about?! Of course you are!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No way! Have you seen Kara? `She's` a child.
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! Have you seen Kara? [color=#3b78e2][i]She's[/i][/color] a child.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, have you not been paying attention? We're `thirteen.` As in, `teenagers.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, have you not been paying attention? We're [color=#3b78e2][i]thirteen.[/i][/color] As in, [color=#3b78e2][i]teenagers.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And pranks are kids' stuff. We're like, totally done with pranks.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Now, we like shopping!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And gossip!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: And reality tv!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess a lot `has` changed while I've been gone.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess a lot [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] changed while I've been gone.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You'd know that if you ever spent any time with us. We're not kids anymore.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that probably means you're not going to like the stuffed unicorns I got you for Christmas.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh, come on! We never would have liked those!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sorry, twins. Look, how about I make it up to you right now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll take you shopping as your Christmas present, and you can pick out whatever you want.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: That's... Kind of awesome, Howard. Thanks! I don't even know where to start...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Let's go to `Pro Makeup Style!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Let's go to [color=#3b78e2][i]Pro Makeup Style![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: No, let's go to `Shoes, Shoes, Shoes!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, let's go to [color=#3b78e2][i]Shoes, Shoes, Shoes![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Howard, tie-breaking vote?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, the twins really have grown up... I never thought they'd disagree about anything!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or that they'd actually ask me for advice!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So, which store?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE and I broke up, but that doesn't take away what we had...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Even if it's kind of depressing to remember it now, I don't want to pretend like it never happened.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: That's a very mature perspective, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Too bad it doesn't make it any easier.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. It just doesn't mean the same thing anymore.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Here, I'll get rid of that for you.
Kay grabs the ornament and throws it in the trash.
Howard winces as the glass shatters and is suddenly filled with regret.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The duck! What have you done?! Can we still put it back together?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Uh, calm down, it's just an ornament.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This ornament is like my relationship with $ZOE! It's broken now, but maybe we can put it back together! Maybe...
Howard's mom pulls him away from the trash.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's obviously upsetting you to see it.

nodes.title: Howard's Holidays
nodes.subtitle: Sometimes coming home is the hardest part...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Howard.
The last time he was in town, he was skipping classes and completely neglecting his studies to see $ZOE, but now Howard's back in town for his `real` holiday break...
nodes.text_bbcode: The last time he was in town, he was skipping classes and completely neglecting his studies to see $ZOE, but now Howard's back in town for his [b]real[/b] holiday break...

nodes.text: It's Christmas Eve, and Howard and his family are decorating their Christmas tree.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard, it's so nice to have you home again! The family's finally back together!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Ee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad to be back. Baby Kara's getting so big...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And things have been so busy at Kingston... I really needed a break.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: We're all proud of you, son.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Howard's great.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Blah blah blah. Come on, this tree isn't decorating itself!
Howard reaches into a box of Christmas ornaments and pulls out a little glass duck wearing a Santa hat.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is an ornament that $ZOE gave me last year...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... Should we get rid of it?

nodes.title: Holiday Special!
nodes.subtitle: A special look at Howard and Paige's holidays!

nodes.prompt: What would you like to do?

options.label: Go back to the season menu.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What would you like to do?

nodes.text: Sometimes coming home is the hardest part...

nodes.prompt: This is ;sudden death overtime;, so the first team to score wins. Do whatever it takes to score!
In overtime, `the first team to score wins`, so don't let them get a touchdown!
A special look at Howard and Paige's holidays!

nodes.text: Paige has no choice... She brings up her hand, slowly painting a perfect pair of smiling lips on the doll.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Perfect! You know, she looks just like you!
Paige stares down at the doll's vacant eyes and painted smile.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What's wrong, Paige? You look sad!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sad. I'm... I'm angry! I don't know what your plan is, but I refuse to let it go on any longer!
Paige shoves back the table and jumps up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wouldn't do that if I were you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Be careful!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm done listening to you. Any of you!
Taylor snaps her fingers, and there's a sparkle of magic around Paige as Taylor tries to hold her still.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Resist Santa Taylor's magic!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't control me!
Paige suddenly feels a jolt run all through her body!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, this is going to be trouble.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm afraid you're right, Paige. You don't belong here. You're not an elf at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you don't belong with Prissy and the other good boys and girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sad to say that you don't belong anywhere!
Another jolt shoots through Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's happening to me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No!
Paige loses focus, and Taylor's magic grips her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nnnuuhhh!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm afraid you're right, Paige. You don't belong here. You're not an elf at all.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you don't belong with Prissy and the other good boys and girls...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sad to say that you don't belong anywhere!
Taylor waves her hand, and Paige feels darkness creeping in around her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where are you sending me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Everything in its place, dear. I don't know where you're going, but wherever it is... It's where you belong.
Darkness closes in all around Paige!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello? Is anyone here?
Paige can't hear anything, feel anything, taste anything, or see anything, and is starting to get really creeped out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Elf girls! Are you here? I'd even tolerate seeing you right now. Crazy power-hungry Santa Taylor? Helloooo?
There's no answer, and the silence stretches on...
...And on...
...And on...
You have reached the end of `Season 3, Episode 8, Howard's Holidays!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 3, Episode 8, Howard's Holidays![/b]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No problem! Thanks for playing, everyone! We love you!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey SHS Fans! It's me, Emily!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Did you know that I'm the main character in Surviving High School, the novel?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's me right there over my shoulder! Weird, right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: The novel features me, Ben, Kimi, Spencer, and a lot of other cool Twin Branches students!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Anyway, the novel is available wherever awesome books are sold `and` is also available in digital form!
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway, the novel is available wherever awesome books are sold [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] is also available in digital form!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: In fact, if you're interested, you can check it out right now!

nodes.prompt: Do you want to check out the SHS novel in iBooks?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you want to check out the SHS novel in iBooks?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sniff... Wait... Is that... Caviar? And popcorn shrimp? Lobster?
Suddenly, Paige's surroundings snap into place. She's in a fancy restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? This is... That restaurant I went to with the girls last year... For New Year's Eve...
What starts as a distant murmur suddenly grows until all around her, Paige hears people talking and laughing!
Suddenly a countdown begins!
The voices begin counting down! 'Five... Four... Three...'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where is everyone? Hello?
Paige runs through the restaurant, but even though she hears people, no one is in sight!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Answer me! Where are you?
'Two... One!' The clock strikes midnight! The crowd cheers! People clink glasses and blow party favors!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where is everyone? Why am I all alone here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why is everyone in this stupid world always leaving me?
Paige slumps to the ground, her head in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Taylor said I belong here... That I don't belong with anyone. But...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't want to be alone... Please... Don't leave me here...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There must be someone...
A beeping sound startles Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wha...?
She looks down and sees her phone buzzing. '1 New Text from Owen.'
Paige awakens with a start, her hand gripped tightly around her phone.
Paige looks down and sees that her phone still reads '1 New Text from Owen.'
Paige taps her phone and reads...
'Okay, rich girl. Don't tell me your fancy cell phone doesn't get reception up in your ivory tower.'
A small smile flits across Paige's face.
And she texts back.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'It's a ski lodge, not an ivory tower... But I hardly expect you to know the difference.'
Paige smiles and curls her hand over her phone, drifting back off to sleep.
Once again, the silence and darkness stretch on...
...And on...
...And on...
Paige can't hear anything, feel anything, taste anything, or see anything, and is starting to get really creeped out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great, I'm going to be stuck forever in some stupid limbo with an uninspired color scheme.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aaaah!
Paige's scream is echoed back at her, magnified a hundred fold!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, that was unpleasant.
Paige rubs at her ears.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great, I'm going to be stuck forever in some stupid limbo with an uninspired color scheme.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great, I'm going to be stuck forever in some stupid limbo with an uninspired color scheme.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now, Paige... Do you remember the first time your parents sent you away?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: My parents? What do they have to do with any of this?
Suddenly, the world shifts around Paige...
And she finds herself in a cold, dark building.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where am I? What is this place?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Paige! There you are.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: $ZOE? What's going on here? Where are we? I want to go back to the lodge.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're both here, Paige, because we don't have parents. This is the Orphanage of Lost Souls.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no staff and no other children. We've been sent here because no one wants to be with us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you're just okay with this? 'Cause your cheerfulness about this is really starting to freak me out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's no point in putting on a sad face about it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, please! Don't play all sugar-gumdrops-and-rainbows with me. We're both in the same boat!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Our parents don't want us. Just face up to it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, my. That's a `very` sad way of looking at things.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, my. That's a [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] sad way of looking at things.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sad! I'm furious! And you should be too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just because our parents aren't with us during the holidays doesn't mean they don't care!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure they're thinking about us `right now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure they're thinking about us [color=#3b78e2][i]right now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, probably laughing it up about how much fun they're having now that they don't have us cluttering up their lives!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can see there's just no reasoning with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But there's no more time for pouting! We've got work to do!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: {{ There's work to do, oh work to do! Scrub the floor, then do another chore! {{

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: {{ Might as well smile! It's going to take a while! {{

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You are `actually` trying to drive me insane, aren't you? Your singing sounds like an accordion in a wood chipper!
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] trying to drive me insane, aren't you? Your singing sounds like an accordion in a wood chipper!

nodes.text: Suddenly, a little kitten slinks up to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Meow? Meow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's that, kitty? You want to help? Why, of course!

nodes.speaker: Unicorn
nodes.text: Neigh! Neigh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Mr. Unicorn, you want to help too? You're so kind!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You have `got` to be kidding me.
nodes.text_bbcode: You have [color=#3b78e2][i]got[/i][/color] to be kidding me.

nodes.text: Just then, the door to the orphanage is thrown open!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm here to save you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!
Owen rushes to $ZOE's side and lifts her high in the air in a big hug!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Dearest!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My love!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, how could anyone resist your charms?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean her deliberate and unjustified enthusiasm? Or her misplaced and obnoxious optimism?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Her spirit. Her cheerfulness, even in the face of difficulties. How could anyone choose you over such a bright spot of sunshine?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not fair! $ZOE is always so `happy!` Why? Why should she always be making the best of everything? How can she be so happy when she has so little?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not fair! $ZOE is always so [color=#3b78e2][i]happy![/i][/color] Why? Why should she always be making the best of everything? How can she be so happy when she has so little?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: $ZOE, I think it's time we leave Paige to her fate.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No. No!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't leave me! That's an order!
But Owen and $ZOE walk out the door with slow, deliberate steps, sparing only a single glance back at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I feel sorry for you, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aargh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, that didn't seem to go very well...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You two. What are you doing back here?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Paige is `never` going to learn her lesson.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] going to learn her lesson.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're right, because there's `no lesson to learn!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You're right, because there's [color=#3b78e2][i]no lesson to learn![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just want to go home!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Paige... You don't have a home.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... But...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Uh oh... Do you hear that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Time's up.
Elf Sam and Elf Amanda freeze! Paige hears the sound of jingling sleigh bells, hooves on the rooftop, and then...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: HO HO HO!
Taylor comes crashing down through the chimney in a huge red sleigh pulled by eight flying reindeer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure. Why not a bunch of reindeer?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Girls! You said you were running out to the store for reindeer food!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We... Um...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. I knew Taylor was on a power trip from being school President, but this is new even for her...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, there's no time for excuses, my little elves. We've got to go!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, Santa Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes, Santa Taylor.
Elf Sam and Elf Amanda climb into Santa Taylor's sleigh.
Santa Taylor looks at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come, come now. It's time for all good little elves to get back to the workshop!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Those toys aren't going to make themselves, you know.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not an elf! And I'm not coming with you!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nonsense. You must be an elf. Why else would you be here with Elf Amanda and Elf Sam?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, I don't know, because they abducted me to teach me some stupid Christmas lesson?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, hah hah! What an active imagination for an elf! Time to put it to work on toys! Bring her in!
Elf Sam and Elf Amanda grab Paige and haul her into the sled!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Get your hands off me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This won't hurt if you stop struggling.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, everyone in?
Santa Taylor snaps her fingers and the world blurs and shifts around Paige...
When everything settles, she's standing in a huge toy store!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My, my! We've got so much to do! The good little children that we're making toys for have already arrived!
Paige looks up and sees a raised seating area that overlooks the workshop. On it, she spots Prissy, Madisenn, and Penelope!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Does that girl down there look kind of like Paige?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige... Yes, I remember her! She wasn't very nice.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please, girls, we don't need to concern ourselves with elves. `They` serve `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, girls, we don't need to concern ourselves with elves. [color=#3b78e2][i]They[/i][/color] serve [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ahem! Speaking of which, I need some more peppermint hot chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right away, Miss.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen?! What's he doing here?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Faster, servant!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yes, of course. I'm so very sorry, Miss.
Owen rushes to bring Prissy her drink.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Very good, servant. You may kiss my hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! Prissy, get away from him!
Paige runs up the staircase to the balcony and pushes Prissy away from Owen!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: How dare you! Do you even know who I am?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elf! This girl is at the top of the 'Nice' list! You have to treat her courteously!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, please. I don't know how things work around here, but I can just about guarantee you that Prissy belongs on the 'Naughty' list.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, sure, I `started` there... But I was able to pay some poor sap to take my place! And with the right 'donations'... I climbed up to the top of the 'Nice' list.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, sure, I [color=#3b78e2][i]started[/i][/color] there... But I was able to pay some poor sap to take my place! And with the right 'donations'... I climbed up to the top of the 'Nice' list.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you hearing this, Santa Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm afraid the list is the list... There's no second-guessing it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, if you won't do anything, I will!
Paige launches herself at Prissy, but Santa Taylor snaps her fingers, and Paige freezes in mid-air!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, dear... Looks like this little elf needs help getting to work!
Santa Taylor snaps her fingers again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What...?
Paige finds herself forced to sit down on a workbench, her hands magically stretched out in front of her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elf Sam! Elf Amanda! This little elf needs some help.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll show her how to be one of us!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: We'll show her what to do!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here, Paige. Start with this doll.
Paige looks down and sees a little princess doll appear in her hands.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Paint a smile on her face!
A paintbrush appears in Paige's hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: There's no need to be insulting.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's every need!

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Such anger, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You haven't even begun to see angry.

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, would a closed-minded person even be talking to her `Pegasus?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, would a closed-minded person even be talking to her [color=#3b78e2][i]Pegasus?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: You are starting to understand.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You know what, just forget it. You've been gone too long, Paige. Things have changed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, Prissy's really trying to undermine me. I didn't realize she was just waiting for me to get out of the way so she could move in as queen bee.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Forget gossip. This is boring. I want to go skiing.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Okay! Should we--

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wait! It's `so` cold outside. I think we should stay here and get another round of this amazing hot chocolate.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cold outside. I think we should stay here and get another round of this amazing hot chocolate.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But it's getting dark, sweetie. We can only ski for another hour before it's too late.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, but that just means it'll be a lot of work getting our ski gear on and then by that time, we'll only get a few minutes to ski!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, girls. We're going skiing!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Um... Er...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Seriously?! What's wrong with them? Are they actually going to question `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously?! What's wrong with them? Are they actually going to question [color=#3b78e2][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Waiter! More hot chocolate!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Fine. Let's just stay here.
Paige scowls while Penelope and Madisenn share an obviously relieved look.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Looks like more's changed while I've been gone than I thought. Prissy's really trying to oust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And my other minions are just going to let it happen!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh!
Paige looks down at her phone on the table and sees a text from Owen... Prissy leans over to look...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Owen? Please tell me it's not that guy from Twin Branches you were talking about. Wasn't he that $ZOE girl's lapdog?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, yeah. He just, I guess he got my number when we did that psych project together.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And now he keeps texting you? What a stalker! But what can you expect from someone like him?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I mean, he literally lives on the wrong side of the tracks. You're not going to text him back, are you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course not! He's not even in my tax bracket!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wow, struck a nerve, huh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just sick of him bothering me.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Let's do something fun! Hey, there's a group of cute guys over there! We could totally party with them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Must we?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Not all of us go to co-ed schools. Don't be so selfish!
Prissy stands and turns to one of the staff members of the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You! I want sparkling blood orange soda!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but we're about to close...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'm sure you realize that the rules don't apply to us. Just ask your manager if you don't believe me. And bring me some warm chocolate chip cookies!

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: But... We don't serve chocolate chip cookies...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, then, go out and get some! Now!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: And we need music!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, play something fun and dance-y!
One of the staff members hastily turns on a radio... Prissy jumps up on the couch and starts dancing!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Now `this` is a party!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] is a party!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, please. This is just like every other year we've gone on a trip together.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Um, yeah, and it's fun.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Come on, Paige! Join us!
The boys near the fireplace stare at Prissy and the other girls. They start whispering to each other, then one of the boys waves for the girls to come over.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Pfft! Like `we'd` ever actually go over to--
nodes.text_bbcode: Pfft! Like [color=#3b78e2][i]we'd[/i][/color] ever actually go over to--

nodes.text: Prissy, Madisenn, and Penelope all rush over toward the guys!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Girls! Girls, wait!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one's even listening to me.
Paige sneaks away from her friends and curls up in one of the chairs on the other side of the lobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Those girls used to follow whatever I said... They were practically afraid of me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And now just because I've been gone a few months, they're treating me like I'm a total stranger!
From there, she watches the other girls and takes out her phone to read Owen's text.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'So did you go with solid-gold skis or solid-diamond?'
Paige stares at the text, torn between replying and deleting it...
Paige is still staring at it as her eyelids start to feel heavy...
And everything goes dark.
When Paige opens her eyes, she's in the stables at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? What... Happened? I must have been daydreaming...
Paige looks down and sees a brush in her hand. In front of her is her horse, William!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello, boy! I bet you want your coat brushed, huh? Well, since there's no stable hands around to help, I guess I can do it...
Paige begins to brush William's coat, looking around...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait a sec... You shouldn't be here. Monarch Prep made you leave when I transferred. You should be at that rent-a-stable Mom made you go to.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why are you here at Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Because this is where I belong, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No way. You talk?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Of course I talk! It's `you` who doesn't always listen.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I talk! It's [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] who doesn't always listen.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I listen! I'm listening right now, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Good. And now, `watch.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Good. And now, [color=#e23b3b][i]watch.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: William rears up and huge, feathered wings unfurl from his sides!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're a pegasus? OMG.
Paige staggers back and runs into someone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, watch it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah, you could hurt someone!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sam? What's going on? Why are you wearing that stupid elf hat? And why are you palling around with the dumb red-head from school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Um, because I'm not Sam. I'm Elf Sam. And this is Elf Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm an elf!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, ha ha, very funny. Come on, Sam. I've known you since your first day at Monarch Prep. You're not an elf.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're wrong.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know you've been `acting` like you don't know me since you sided with your cousin $ZOE over the whole Social Chair thing, but we used to be friends.
nodes.text_bbcode: I know you've been [color=#3b78e2][i]acting[/i][/color] like you don't know me since you sided with your cousin $ZOE over the whole Social Chair thing, but we used to be friends.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Who drove you to see Colt when he came back into your life? Who showed you how to stand up to Prissy? Do you even remember the Key Lime Pie Incident?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Of course I remember all of those things! I just mean that I'm an elf, and I've always been an elf. That's why I never `really` fit in at Monarch Prep. I belong with other elves. You don't remember?
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course I remember all of those things! I just mean that I'm an elf, and I've always been an elf. That's why I never [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] fit in at Monarch Prep. I belong with other elves. You don't remember?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um, I kind of think I'd remember a little thing like elf ears and a pointy hat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Saaaam! Don't forget! We've got to hurry or we'll be late!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Late for what? What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're here to take you somewhere.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: William
nodes.text: Open your mind, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you saying...

options.label: A horse is going to teach me some life lessons?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Really? I totally sided with David!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I mean, yeah. He had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he `was` out of the country...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, yeah. He had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] out of the country...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, `that` David and Jennifer... I thought you meant... Some other couple...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] David and Jennifer... I thought you meant... Some other couple...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please, Paige. You know you're clueless about this.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Jennifer's a senior who just transferred in. David's obviously her ex-boyfriend who was always coming to visit.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Well, he had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he `was` out of the country...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, he had a point that she probably shouldn't be making out with other guys, even if he [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] out of the country...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh, please. You don't even know who these people really are.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I know they just broke up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Um... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh! And you probably didn't hear about the huge breakup that happened!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Jennifer and David broke up last month!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jennifer and David? Who `are` these people?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Jennifer and David? Who [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] these people?!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It was `very` messy.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was [color=#3b78e2][i]very[/i][/color] messy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I totally sided with David. What do you think, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Um... I'm on...

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I know, right?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, really, who would believe that you'd fail a test?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You really can't understand until you see him, Paige. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really, Pen. This is what happens when I'm not around?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Hey! Don't judge me! You've never even met him!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You really can't understand until you see him, Paige. Trust me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well. Fine.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Um...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, I guess he must... Um... Be... Really hot!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Way to contribute. But honestly...

nodes.title: Paige's Nightmare After Christmas
nodes.subtitle: Can Paige escape her worst nightmare?

nodes.text: You are now playing as Paige.
It's the day after Christmas, and Paige's mother has sent her off with her Monarch Prep friends to a ski lodge up in the mountains.
The girls laze about the hotel lounge, ordering expensive food and drinks and gossiping next to a roaring fire.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige, it's `so` nice to have you back with us! I feel like we haven't seen you in forever!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] nice to have you back with us! I feel like we haven't seen you in forever!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I've been busy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's nice to know that even if things at Twin Branches aren't always working out for me, I still have my loyal minions from Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It was really cool of your mom to let you come on the trip with us!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please. It was the least she could do. Now that she's marrying Tad, the `last` thing she wants is me lurking around during their perfect holiday together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Please. It was the least she could do. Now that she's marrying Tad, the [color=#3b78e2][i]last[/i][/color] thing she wants is me lurking around during their perfect holiday together.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Oh, don't tell me you're bitter about this? Tad's loaded. You're going to be set once your mom locks him down.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You could even come back to Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Huh? Oh... Right. Yeah, I guess that's true.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: OMG, that would be great!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah... The `best...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... The [color=#3b78e2][i]best...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I mean, you've just missed `so` much since you've been gone.
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you've just missed [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much since you've been gone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, I'm sure I haven't missed that much. Good old Monarch Prep never really changes.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I wouldn't be too sure about that. Like, you haven't even seen the new chemistry teacher.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Squee! Professor Ting! He's `so` hot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Squee! Professor Ting! He's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] hot!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I failed a test just so he'd talk to me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow. That's...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi, it's fine. It's just a dance...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, one of the `ten` you have left in your high school career! You'll never get these memories back if they don't get made!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, one of the [color=#3b78e2][i]ten[/i][/color] you have left in your high school career! You'll never get these memories back if they don't get made!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Maybe I just won't go.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You have to, Em! If you don't go, I can't go... Who'd go with me after the Spreadsheet Disaster of 2012?!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's just... It was supposed to be a big date night with Ben, and now it's not as special...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, you can `make` it special... Make it a girls' night with Kimi.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, you can [color=#3b78e2][i]make[/i][/color] it special... Make it a girls' night with Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `Kimi` likes this idea.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Kimi[/i][/color] likes this idea.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You can dress up together, make each other over, take lots of pictures...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And since it was partially my fault, I'll...
Ben does more layups on his own, while Owen heads over to talk to Paige for a second.
Nick keeps snapping pictures...
You are now playing as $ZOE...
As the girls move to the accessorizing phase of their Girls' Night, Emily's phone buzzes!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: It's a picture from Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Aww, he looks so cute in his basketball uniform!
Emily shows the picture to Sam and Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooh! He looks like a movie star in a sports movie!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He's not my boyfriend, but I'll say it. For a skinny guy, he's got nice legs!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Should I be jealous?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I want to see!
Emily shows $ZOE the picture.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! He looks so--

$ZOE stomach drops when she sees what's going on in the background of the picture... Paige is there in the front row of the bleachers, leaning forward, her arms wrapped around Owen, giving him a huge hug!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...
Later, after everyone's had a chance to dribble...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All right. Now we're going to work on passing. Partner up.
Ben sees Owen and Spencer partner up right away. As the rest of the guys find partners, he's left with the only remaining player.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Looks like it's us, Benjamin!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Can you pass, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Can I? `Can I?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Can I? [color=#e23b3b][i]Can I?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh... Can you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No. I can't. I lack advanced motor skills.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I want all of you to sidestep across from your partner down the court while passing the ball back and forth!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Your passes should start from your chest and hit your partner in the chest! Now go!
The other pairings begin sidestepping down the court, basketballs zipping between them.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hu-ho! This drill's my favorite! It's like high-speed sharing!
Ben and Erik begin sidestepping parallel from each other down the court! Ben's got the basketball in his hands. He passes from his...
Ben watches as Jacob easily dribbles past the defenders, one after the other.
Finally, it's Ben's turn. Jacob starts dribbling to Ben's right, and Ben...
Ben steps off the baseline and onto the court on defense, guarding Andy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! How are you at rebounding?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Pretty fierce. How do you think I lost my eye?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Just kidding...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Or am I?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I honestly don't know how to feel now.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Then you're right where I want you...
Coach shoots the ball, and Ben...

options.label: Keeps Andy in front of him!

nodes.text: And Jacob flies past him!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I guess that was bad technique...
And that's when she remembers Sam. She looks over and sees Nick pulling Sam to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Careful there. Apparently the hallways are a dangerous place.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Apparently.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't stand in front of swinging doors.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It does seem like a dangerous habit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You could say that.
They stand that way for a moment longer, then Sam abruptly pulls back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, nice catch, Nick! But I have to help $ZOE with her things. Bye!
Sam takes $ZOE's arm and walks quickly down the hall with her.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You two looked awfully comfortable. What was that all about?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `That` was nothing. He was just being nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was nothing. He was just being nice.

nodes.text: $ZOE stops Sam next to another bulletin board and finishes putting the remaining posters up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-huh. You know... `Nick` is single, or so I've heard.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh-huh. You know... [color=#3b78e2][i]Nick[/i][/color] is single, or so I've heard.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been on that roller coaster ride, and I'm not standing in line again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even if I've forgiven him, there's still that big elephant in the room that we're not talking about.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Elephant in the room?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Sara.` It just... Wouldn't be right. He loved her. There hasn't been enough time for him to get over her.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara.[/i][/color] It just... Wouldn't be right. He loved her. There hasn't been enough time for him to get over her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And like I told you, I don't want to be `second`, especially to someone who... You know.
nodes.text_bbcode: And like I told you, I don't want to be [color=#3b78e2][i]second[/i][/color], especially to someone who... You know.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick and I will never get together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That may be true, but that doesn't mean you can't go to the dance as friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Maybe. Who are you even going with? Owen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think he's interested in me anymore. I saw him the other night... With Paige.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What were they doing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know, but they seem really close. And Owen said something about `what happened the other night.` What does that mean?
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know, but they seem really close. And Owen said something about [color=#3b78e2][i]what happened the other night.[/i][/color] What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So? That could mean anything. It could be a school project they're working on...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I'm sure Paige cares about `school.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Because I'm sure Paige cares about [color=#3b78e2][i]school.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. Maybe he ran into her car in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just saying... You don't know the entire story. It might not be what you think.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Paige and Owen hate each other...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Do` they?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Do[/i][/color] they?

nodes.text: $ZOE's phone beeps. She glances at the text.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's Taylor... She wants to see me. I should go. But thanks for coming with me to put the posters up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right. I'll see you after school. We can talk about Owen later.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah...
$ZOE steps into Taylor's office.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hey there, Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Ms. President. What did you need me for?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's time to take your powers for a spin. I'm taking you out to introduce you to all the cliques.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't a lot of the cliques already know me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure, they know you at the lunch table or during a football game or in class.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But it's a little different when you're in power.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In power?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, Social Chair. They all voted for you. They put you in charge. That gives you power.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is all so exciting!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's not even 8 in the morning, and you're this excited. Is there an anti-energy drink you could have that would make you `less` perky?
nodes.text_bbcode: It's not even 8 in the morning, and you're this excited. Is there an anti-energy drink you could have that would make you [color=#3b78e2][i]less[/i][/color] perky?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not that I know of!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! It's a good opportunity to invite everyone personally to the planning meeting I'm hosting for the Snow Ball.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't wait to hear everyone's opinions on how to decorate it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's... Sweet. Are you sure that's a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, first of all, there are a bunch of school rules about what can and can't be displayed in a yearbook.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And second of all, using Autumn's photos would mean using up more pages in the yearbook when there are strict limitations...
Taylor stops.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh great, I just bored myself talking. I've been hanging around Justin way too long.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you get what I mean, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah... School limitations. Got it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, let's move. We have a whole bunch of cliques to get through, and first period's coming up soon!
Taylor and $ZOE step into the library where the nerds are in the middle of a tabletop role-playing game.
They're sitting around a gigantic map while Ashley consults from a book with a panda on its cover, narrating events.

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Andrew's character, Andronicus, attacks and vanquishes the hideous dragon! As the dragon fades away, they free the mystical Pandas of Pandaton!

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: For their bravery, the pandas reward the adventurers by showing them a stack of gold. The adventurers rush forward to claim it--

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And are stopped in their tracks by a flaming wall conjured by Andronicus the Great!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What is the meaning of this, Andronicus?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: The gold is all mine, suckers. You shall not take it from me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can't keep all the gold for yourself... That's tyranny!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I, for one, know that our founding fathers would not approve.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I can tell you who else doesn't approve... Everyone who helped you slay the dragon!
Taylor clears her throat.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As fun as it is listening to you guys quest, I wanted to...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait, did you finish the Fantastical Fogs of Pandaton `without me?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, did you finish the Fantastical Fogs of Pandaton [color=#3b78e2][i]without me?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Sorry, Taylor. But... You haven't been coming lately, and we `really` wanted to play...
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, Taylor. But... You haven't been coming lately, and we [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] wanted to play...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Until Andrew here stole our moment of glory!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What is Andrew doing now?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: You are not speaking to Andrew. You are speaking to `Andronicus the Great!` The slayer of dragons! The king of men!
nodes.text_bbcode: You are not speaking to Andrew. You are speaking to [color=#e23b3b][i]Andronicus the Great![/i][/color] The slayer of dragons! The king of men!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He conquered an island of two people, and the power's gone straight to his head...

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Andronicus the Great is not gentle or rational. He is chaotic and prone to bouts of narcissism!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And it is his right to take the gold as the true hero.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't quite get what's going on here.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Andrew made the killing blow on the evil dragon, and he feels he's entitled to all the gold.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `I` don't feel entitled. `Andronicus the Great` feels entitled.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] don't feel entitled. [color=#e23b3b][i]Andronicus the Great[/i][/color] feels entitled.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And how is that any different?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: I'm `me`, and Andronicus is `my character.` When we first started this mission, I created a vain, selfish personality profile for Andronicus.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color], and Andronicus is [color=#e23b3b][i]my character.[/i][/color] When we first started this mission, I created a vain, selfish personality profile for Andronicus.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And he's exactly the type of person who'd betray you all for a mountain of riches...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Enough of that! You only killed the beast because we helped you weaken the monster! You wouldn't be 'the Great' anything without us!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah! If you think this party is letting you take all the gold after all the resources we've put into it, then you've got another thing coming.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: All right, we don't have to go there. Can't you guys just settle it amicably? Andrew, share the gold.

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: `I` would love to, but my other self would have to endure a life-changing catalyst and several years of the love of a beautiful elf maiden before he'd ever entrust anyone else with the loot!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] would love to, but my other self would have to endure a life-changing catalyst and several years of the love of a beautiful elf maiden before he'd ever entrust anyone else with the loot!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: And it's easy for you to say 'Share', but how does Andronicus know that the ranger, `Taylor the Swift` isn't just encouraging the sharing of wealth, so she can profit from a timely trade with Brendanimal?
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's easy for you to say 'Share', but how does Andronicus know that the ranger, [color=#e23b3b][i]Taylor the Swift[/i][/color] isn't just encouraging the sharing of wealth, so she can profit from a timely trade with Brendanimal?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I would never--I mean, `Taylor the Swift` would never do that!
nodes.text_bbcode: I would never--I mean, [color=#3b78e2][i]Taylor the Swift[/i][/color] would never do that!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: There's a perfectly rational way to settle this. $ZOE, you're the only person with no vested interest. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Andrew is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I'll stop by her office now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Be safe and good luck! I need to head to class.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, I'll need it...
$ZOE grabs her textbooks for her morning classes and heads back into the treacherous hallway to get to Taylor's office.
She gets about halfway down the hall when she hears some screams from the pack of cheerleaders in front of her!
The cheerleaders part, and $ZOE suddenly sees the rebels launch a water balloon, right towards her! She jumps out of the way with a loud squeal!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeeeeek!
The rebels advance, each carrying a balloon launcher!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And that's just wave one!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You guys are completely psycho!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yep!
More water balloons are launched at them! $ZOE and some of the other cheerleaders duck into an unused classroom for cover.
After a few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Do you think it's safe now? Surely they're gone by now...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Are you insane? That's what they want you to think. You're about to walk straight into a trap. These hallways aren't safe anymore!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure it's not as bad as all that...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yes, it is!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Well, if we're ever going to get to class, we need to see what's out there... And I volunteer Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What? No!
Jill opens the door and shoves Keith out. He flinches as he staggers outside, but nothing happens. The girls watch with the door cracked open partially.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Hey, I think we're...
A water balloon hits the side of Keith's head, exploding in an impressive burst of water!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Cold! That's cold! Who throws water balloons in winter?!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Where are they?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't know! But I'm running! Get out while you still can!
Keith takes off down the hall. The other cheerleaders peer around the corner, then sprint into the hallway.
$ZOE sprints out, trying to get her bearings. And that's when she sees another balloon coming straight for her face! She freezes in place, the balloon moving as if in slow motion...
She thinks about the care she put into her wardrobe that morning, and she hopes the balloon won't hit too hard...
And that's when Owen steps in and casually bats it away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't thank me yet! There's another round coming!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Take this!
Owen takes $ZOE's hand, and together they run away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! And don't let go!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was in the right place at the right time.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I'm surprised it's such a zoo in there. What happened?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm afraid that's my fault.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Your fault? No way you could stir up something like this... You're so sweet.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, but... Really, it is my fault.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember that planning meeting yesterday? I couldn't pick a date for the dance, and that made everyone upset.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really let people down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, you didn't. It's not like people are mad at `you,` are they?
nodes.text_bbcode: No, you didn't. It's not like people are mad at [color=#e23b3b][i]you,[/i][/color] are they?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess not. But people are fighting because of something I did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And it's my job to make it right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Need some help? I'm not really good at organizing, but I can nod my head a lot and pretend like I'm listening. I'll even say, 'Ooh, good idea!' every once in a while.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha... That's okay. I have a date in mind. I'll be announcing it soon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's enough about my stupid stuff. How are you doing, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Last time I saw you, you were trying out for...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I just wish I could say the same for Emily...
You are now playing as Owen...
Owen arrives at the massive, ornate front door of Paige's family estate.
He doesn't see any people and can't hear any noise coming from within the house.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, I'm only a little bit late. But where is everyone? I don't want to be the first guy here!
He takes out his phone and calls Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Owen! Did you see it? I can't believe Surf 'N' Turf Murph broke that katana with his face!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I thought he was a goner when Tres Samurai hypnotized him with their anthem... Sushi Rolls in Mexico City. Have you been watching?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm at Paige's party. Are you coming?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Uh, I didn't hear anything about a party, dude.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, sorry. I guess she didn't invite you.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Big surprise.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't know anyone going to this thing?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nope. Just hearing about it now. You know who you should ask? $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Somehow I doubt that $ZOE's anywhere near the top of Paige's invite list.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, but if there's something going on, $ZOE probably knows about it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good point... Actually, I could see Paige making a big deal to $ZOE about how she's `not` invited.
nodes.text_bbcode: Good point... Actually, I could see Paige making a big deal to $ZOE about how she's [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] invited.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I could see that too... And then $ZOE would get all mad, and say something about how Paige is just jealous because she didn't win Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Would she?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Then Paige runs up to $ZOE and starts pulling her hair, and then they fall down in some mud, and then $ZOE puts Paige into a Pretzel Twist Suplex!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Pow! Then--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey! Spencer! Want to check back into reality?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoops. Sorry, bro, my mind's on wrestling! Anyway, commercials over, gotta roll! Call $ZOE!
Spencer hangs up, and Owen calls up $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen... Hi.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE! Happy Thanksgiving!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You too...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is everything okay?
There's a pause on the line, then...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, sorry. Everything's fine. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, well, I'm just about to go into... Uh... Into...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You've got one second to convince me not to just get up and leave. My grandma's staying up later than her usual bedtime to make a nice meal for me!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just stay, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why should I? You lied to me, Paige! You used me to try and impress your mom.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you that dumb?! You think I had you come here to `impress` my mother?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you that dumb?! You think I had you come here to [color=#3b78e2][i]impress[/i][/color] my mother?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're like the least impressive guy I know!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, that about does it.
Owen stands, prepared to leave. Paige grabs his arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait. Don't go!
Owen's eyes meet Paige's, and he sees something in them, a vulnerability he's not used to.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll sit if you tell me what this is about.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay, I will...
You are now playing as Ben...
Ben steps outside the Kessler house and finds Emily there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I don't know... It's really weird to see my dad treat you like you're the President of the Universe.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh. I don't mind.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know you don't, and that's part of what's bothering me.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You don't like me trying to impress him?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Impressing him's fine, Ben. I just want to make sure you're not impressing him with some fake version of yourself.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I want you to be you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And I'm telling you, Emily. I am being me.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Are you? Do you care about basketball? If I told you that I `really` wanted you to go to the dance, would you skip your game?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you? Do you care about basketball? If I told you that I [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] wanted you to go to the dance, would you skip your game?

nodes.prompt: Would you skip the big game?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Would you skip the big game?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I, uh, I should probably get going. Coach has a short fuse.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Of course. I hate this, Ben. I want to be there to support you. But I've got a swim meet early tomorrow morning, and your game is so far away.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I have to go home as soon as the dance ends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I know. Look, it's a total longshot, but if the game happens to end really early, I'll do everything I can to get back here...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Long before you turn back into a pumpkin!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I think you've got your fairy tales mixed up, but I appreciate the sentiment. Beat 'em quick, okay?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course! I'll win for you and your dad!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Or just me...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right. Just you.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: And hey, even if we can't be there for each other, we can still make the night fun.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: How?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll send you pictures of my night from my phone, and you can send me pictures of the dance from yours!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It'll be like you're at the game, and I'm at the dance!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I like it.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Yeah.
Emily steps closer to Ben and kisses him!
The bus's engine roars to life! Coach sticks his head out the door!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Harris! If you don't want come to this game, that's fine by me! We'll play with four guys if we have to!
The bus's gears shake, and the bus starts pulling away from the curb!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh oh! Gotta go!
Ben turns toward the bus, but Owen runs right into him. The two fall over in a heap!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Get up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's not going to leave us, is he?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who knows?! Coach is crazy, man!
As the bus pulls out of the parking lot, Ben and Owen scramble to their feet!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Do you or don't you want to play today?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Run!
It's the end of the game. And with just ten seconds left, Willow Glen is only ahead by two points.
Jacob dribbles the ball across half-court and flips it to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Andy's being double-teamed!
Spencer sets a screen for Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is it... My chance to win the game with a three-pointer!
Ben's eyes drift to the crowd for just a moment... And he remembers that Emily isn't there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's at the dance...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh!
Ben curls off Spencer's screen, catches a behind-the-back pass from Erik, turns, and shoots!
The ball hangs in the air, falls toward the hoop...
And clangs off the back of the rim!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I missed... We lost...
As the Twin Branches players sulk off the court, Lars walks past Ben and chucks him with his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Survival of the fittest... And it looks like you guys are dodos!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll crush you in Sectionals! I swear it!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Ha! That'll never happen because you won't even make it to Sectionals!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grr!
In the locker room, Coach wraps up his speech to the guys...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I'll see you on the bus!
He leaves in a huff, grumbling about his ex-wife.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, that sucked.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I `hate` losing! Stupid fortune teller!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]hate[/i][/color] losing! Stupid fortune teller!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Fortune teller?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, the fortune teller from the Halloween Dance... She told me I'd `win what really mattered!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, the fortune teller from the Halloween Dance... She told me I'd [color=#e23b3b][i]win what really mattered![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What a quack!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're still not out yet, Spence. Maybe our next game against Wilson High's what really matters!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: We're done, man!
Remembering Madame Fortuna, Owen glances unconsciously off to the left...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's just a fortune teller, guys. I mean, she told me something completely unhelpful and vague. It doesn't mean anything!
Nearby, Nick snaps a picture of the team.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now is `not` the time, Brown!
nodes.text_bbcode: Now is [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] the time, Brown!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry... I just needed a candid for the paper. I'll put the camera away.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It feels like I'm heartbroken in my stomach.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If I hear the name Lars chanted ever again, I will rip my own ears off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess all we can do is look on the bright side, right fellas?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: What bright side? We just got pummeled by a guy whose head looks like a mop!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I mean, at least it was quick--

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Wait, how quick?!
Ben starts scrambling through his gym bag for his phone! He checks the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The dance! It isn't over! We can still make it!
Out in the parking lot, all is still save for the lazy sound of a few crickets...
Then the locker room doors burst open! The basketball team sprints out, running toward the bus!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Must. Text. Emily!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Why don't you call her, stupid?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Too late! I'm already texting, and my phone battery's about to die!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm cramping up! I'm cramping up!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not an athlete! My skinny jeans feel like they're on fire! So hot!
Ben's holding his phone out as he runs!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I want to text, 'Game over. Be there soon!' as fast as possible!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I've got to be efficient with my texts, even if it means using shorthand!
Ben types out the first word...

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Okay, boys, enough games! It's almost time for the countdown!
Beth steps up, turns off the game system, and flips the tv channel to 'The Rockin' and Rollin' New Year's Eve Extravaganza!'
Howard is watching when suddenly a girl puts her hand on his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Howard?! That must be you! I'd recognize you anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that... Elliana? You haven't changed a bit! I haven't seen you since... Since...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Since we went to that dance together during your sophomore year? I know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I thought you went back to Brazil!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hee hee, I did, for a while. But I got into another exchange program at Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And then I moved here permanently to go to Centerscore U!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow. It's just... I can't believe you're here.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I know, right? You've grown up so much.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You make it sound like I was a kid when we went out together.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hee hee! Well, it `was` pretty obvious that I was the first girl you'd ever dated.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hee hee! Well, it [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] pretty obvious that I was the first girl you'd ever dated.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I remember... I really thought...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: That we were meant to be? That you were in love?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that I'd never get over you!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: It's funny, isn't it? As much as we believe when we're younger that every heartbreak is forever... Time really does heal all wounds.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: And life goes on. You grow up, you fall in love again...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the past becomes the past. Yeah. It's kind of hard to remember that when you're in the middle of it, of course.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Of course! That's the charm of being young.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh. I'm not sure I'll ever grow out of it.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Oh, that's right... I heard someone mention... You just had a bad break up, didn't you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. And I have to admit... It's hard to see it getting any better.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Well. Tonight is the night for leaving the past behind, isn't it?
On the television, a countdown starts! People in the room chant along...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Ten! Nine!

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Eight! Seven!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: A new year... A chance to start over.

nodes.speaker: Beth
nodes.text: Six! Five!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What if I can't?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Four!

nodes.speaker: Raven
nodes.text: Three!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: There's only one way to find out.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Two!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: One!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Happy new year!
Elliana leans in towards Howard...

nodes.text: Jacob cuts back to Ben's left, and Ben...
Jacob suddenly speeds up, trying to blow by Ben!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Stay down, Kale!
As Jacob accelerates, Ben...
Ben steps off the baseline and onto the court on defense, guarding Andy.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey! How are you at rebounding?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Pretty fierce. How do you think I lost my eye?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gulp!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Just kidding...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Or am I?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I honestly don't know how to feel now.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Then you're right where I want you...
Coach shoots the ball, and Ben...

options.label: Keeps Andy in front of him!

nodes.text: Ben whispers to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, boxing out?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! I explained this in the gym yesterday!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Could you explain it again?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: No! There's no time! Figure it out!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All right, everyone! Time for rebounding!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I got this!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Half of you on offense, half of you on defense!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: When I shoot the ball, the defense needs to box out and get the rebound!
She whirls around, looking around for the exit, when she sees Hannah shaking up two cans of soda in each hand.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Drink this, nerds!
$ZOE realizes she's in the way and...
When it's over, $ZOE scrambles from underneath the length of the table and sets her eyes on the exit door...
The only thing blocking her way to the exit is the exchange of meatballs thrown between the nerds and the journalism club...
She sees the rhythm of the volleys and starts running through!
In the corner of her eye, she sees a couple meatballs fly in her direction!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Harris! I'm tired of watching you miss layups! Everybody but you `on the baseline!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Harris! I'm tired of watching you miss layups! Everybody but you [color=#e23b3b][i]on the baseline![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The other players run to the baseline.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All of you are going to run every time Harris here misses a layup!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No pressure! You can do this, Owen!
Owen dribbles toward the hoop for a layup and...
Back comes Willow Glen, their point guard handling the ball across the half-court line...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If Lars gets the ball, I'm going to let him think he's open, but then I'll disrupt his vision!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Newton's Law of Motion... I'm in motion, and I'm going to keep on moving right past you!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unless the object is acted on by another force... In this case, me!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha! Scienced!
Lars catches a pass from the point guard. Ben sets his trap, giving Lars a little bit of space...
Lars takes the bait, picking up his dribble and lining up his shot!
Ben reaches out, trying to block...
You have failed.
