nodes.title: Howard's Holidays
nodes.subtitle: Sometimes coming home is the hardest part...

nodes.text: You are now playing as Howard.
The last time he was in town, he was skipping classes and completely neglecting his studies to see $ZOE, but now Howard's back in town for his `real` holiday break...
nodes.text_bbcode: The last time he was in town, he was skipping classes and completely neglecting his studies to see $ZOE, but now Howard's back in town for his [b]real[/b] holiday break...

nodes.text: It's Christmas Eve, and Howard and his family are decorating their Christmas tree.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard, it's so nice to have you home again! The family's finally back together!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Ee!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm glad to be back. Baby Kara's getting so big...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And things have been so busy at Kingston... I really needed a break.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: We're all proud of you, son.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Howard's great.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Blah blah blah. Come on, this tree isn't decorating itself!
Howard reaches into a box of Christmas ornaments and pulls out a little glass duck wearing a Santa hat.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is an ornament that $ZOE gave me last year...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... Should we get rid of it?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: We'll start with dribbling! Everybody line up!
The players get in a line.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: To assess your basic dribbling ability, you're going to grab a ball, dribble to the end of the court, `pivot,` and come back here!
nodes.text_bbcode: To assess your basic dribbling ability, you're going to grab a ball, dribble to the end of the court, [color=#e23b3b][i]pivot,[/i][/color] and come back here!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I don't think I have to tell you your head should be up while you dribble and `not` admiring your own legs...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think I have to tell you your head should be up while you dribble and [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] admiring your own legs...

nodes.text: Some of the more experienced players laugh.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha! Of course! Head up!
Coach glares at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ahem.
Coach passes a basketball right into Ben's gut!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Go ahead!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Here goes nothing!
And the cafeteria explodes into chaos!
All around $ZOE, food starts flying everywhere! A fruit cup hits Erik in the face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: May day! May day! Pilot down!
Erik falls to the floor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No!
Beside $ZOE, Taylor has her hands up, covering her face. A few feet away, one of the rebels aims a chocolate cup in her direction...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, watch--
Suddenly Justin leaps out of the crowd, running for Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Assassination attempt!
Justin jumps in front of Taylor, the pudding cup hitting him in the chest. He lays on the ground panting.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Madame President... Save yourself...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Justin... You will be avenged. If I get out of here untouched!
Taylor rolls to the side, just in time to avoid globs of chocolate pudding.
$ZOE realizes she's left in the open! A volley of yogurt cups heads in her direction!
She looks around and frantically grabs for...
$ZOE has been soaked.

nodes.text: Owen takes $ZOE's hand, and together they run away!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! And don't let go!
In the cafeteria, $ZOE and Taylor stand on top of a lunch table, surveying the room.
The general unrest of the school has permeated to lunch, and even now, $ZOE can see spitballs and paper planes flying around the groups.
The students seem oblivious to $ZOE and Taylor, standing above the rest of them like giants.
Taylor cups her hands around her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is your Student Body President speaking! Everyone, shut up, or I'm canceling all your sports events!
The room quiets down immediately, and $ZOE begins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've decided on a date for the dance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: After mulling it over, the best day for the dance is...
'The second Saturday' hangs on her lips, as $ZOE thinks of Owen and Emily...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The best day is the...
You are now playing as $ZOE...
As Owen and Ben hop on the bus in the distance, $ZOE, Emily, and Sam look at each other.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We've got a dance in a couple of hours, and none of us have dates...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Kimi and I are going to start our Girls' Night at the salon! You two should join us!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We'll go get our nails done at this place near Emily's house. Emily, you can ride with me.
The girls laugh excitedly as they head toward their cars.
As $ZOE is about to reach hers, Nate comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE! Wait up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, I have to go. I'm meeting up with the girls right now.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Then I'll only ask for a minute of your time instead of the five I was hoping for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How considerate. I don't really want to talk to you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I know I messed up with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Messed up? You almost punched Keith at Homecoming, you lied about what was in that manila folder with the bobcat on it, and you were the last one to talk to Howard before he broke up with me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think you've done more than just mess up!
$ZOE opens her car door, and Nate steps aside.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Don't you think I deserve a chance to defend myself?
$ZOE stops herself from getting into her car. She turns to him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Make it quick.
Nate takes a big, deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I... I lied about what the folder was. I knew that Owen was covering up how he'd put that kid in the hospital. I didn't trust him.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I figured someone who runs from his problems wasn't someone you should be trusting either!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All he wanted was a clean slate!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, maybe that's what I'm hoping for now...
This catches $ZOE off-guard.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: And as for Howard, all I told him was what he needed to hear. That he was holding you back... That he couldn't be there for you...
The bus's engine roars to life! Coach sticks his head out the door!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Kale! Harris! If you don't want come to this game, that's fine by me! We'll play with four guys if we have to!
The bus's gears shake, and the bus starts pulling away from the curb!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh oh! Gotta go!
Ben turns toward the bus, but Owen runs right into him. The two fall over in a heap!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Get up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: He's not going to leave us, is he?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Who knows?! Coach is crazy, man!
As the bus pulls out of the parking lot, Ben and Owen scramble to their feet!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Do you or don't you want to play today?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on! Run!
Ben just stands there and watches as Lars nails a jump shot in his face!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! Are you playing zombie defense?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Don't be sorry! Snap out of it and do something!
Ben inbounds the ball to Andy, who dribbles all the way downcourt for a long jump shot... And completely misses the hoop!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whoops!
Mal sneaks out of bed, edging towards the door. He opens it quietly and stares into the darkness.
A huge, shadowy figure creeps down the stairs, a large bag in one hand and what looks to be a crowbar in the other.
Mal follows him down the hall and down the stairs to the living room.
Despite the Christmas lights, it's still difficult to see. Mal can only make out the figure stealing one of the gifts and putting it into a giant bag!

nodes.speaker: Mal
nodes.text: Oh no you don't...
Mal shoots forward to...
The room has changed! Your familiar bedroom is gone, and the room has become an ice skating rink!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Um, $CADY, is now really the time to be changing your room's appearance?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I didn't do this! Arinna, did you just change my room?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: No! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Only a student assigned to this room would be able to alter it... Cady, are you sure you didn't think of this... Place?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Believe me, I have no idea where this is. But I did see someone... A shadow...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not imagining things?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Positive. I... Look!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What the...? Did you see her?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Something strange is happening. Rig'Rhalla, the beast of dread, is taunting us!
Snow begins to softly fall...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, did you shake your snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have not moved it! This is most strange...
You hear a sound like soft footsteps and imprints begin appearing in the snow on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Do you see that? It's...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I believe they are footprints!
As you watch, delicate, small footprints appear one at a time in the snow in front of you!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely creepy.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I do not understand... Rig'Rhalla has tentacles, not feet...
The falling snow swirls in a chilling gust of wind. The footprints suddenly stop... And turn.
The lights flicker and then...

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: You...
The ghostly and shadowy form of a young girl stands before you. She's about your age, with dark black tears tracked down her face.
You are now playing as Ben.
Spencer is practicing layups during lunch when Ben and Owen step into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I'm guessing you didn't call us here to help with your chemistry homework.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Ben Kale! Owen... Whatever your last name is! Get over here!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How do you not know my last name?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up and listen! The other day, you said I should think about training for something `not football,` and I put two and two together.
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up and listen! The other day, you said I should think about training for something [color=#e23b3b][i]not football,[/i][/color] and I put two and two together.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Basketball is the answer!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure two and two makes four, but basketball might earn you partial credit.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'd smack you for that if I weren't so happy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, what are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Tryouts start tomorrow! We have to get ready!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Did I stutter? Yes. We!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I need to play `something.` Owen, you need a sport to get your head clear, and Ben...
nodes.text_bbcode: I need to play [color=#e23b3b][i]something.[/i][/color] Owen, you need a sport to get your head clear, and Ben...

nodes.text: Spencer eyes Ben's lanky frame.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Actually, I'm really just trying to get Owen to join the team.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Then why'd you invite me here?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I didn't think you'd actually come! It's like when you invite me to one of your study sessions.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I actually `want` you to study!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I actually [color=#e23b3b][i]want[/i][/color] you to study!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well, The point is... Owen's an athlete, and you're the guy who always gets picked last. You know what I mean, right?

nodes.prompt: Hold up... I thought you guys were cool after the last Kessler dinner?

options.label: No, why don't you explain it?!

nodes.text: You are now playing as Ben.
In the gym, Ben lines up on the baseline next to Owen and Spencer. They stand beside a bunch of guys in shorts and high-tops, waiting for Coach to arrive.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, guys.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! Ha! What are you doing, man?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Trying out!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Really? Then this just turned funny.
Ben ignores Spencer and looks down at the line of players.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: So, who was on the team last year?

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: I was.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Same here. Phil was too, but I don't think he's trying out this year, so we'll need some rebounding.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was on the team, but according to Coach, my chances of making the team again are the same as him 're-marrying his bat-faced ex-wife.'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So I'm hopeful love was in the air this off-season!
Spencer nudges Owen.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Making the team is going to be easier than we thought.
Just then the gym doors fly open, and a scrappy, fearsome-looking man comes marching in!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Listen up, knuckle-draggers! There are twelve of you here! I'm allowed to put twelve on my team!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: But if circumstances call for it, I won't hesitate to cut you down to `five!` That means all of you have to `earn` a spot!
nodes.text_bbcode: But if circumstances call for it, I won't hesitate to cut you down to [color=#e23b3b][i]five![/i][/color] That means all of you have to [color=#e23b3b][i]earn[/i][/color] a spot!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But what about subs?

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ericson! Do I look like a man who cares about having players on my bench?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't know. What physical traits correspond to that attitude?!
Ben's phone beeps in his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Probably a text from Emily...
He reaches for his phone--

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Who brought a phone onto my sacred court?!
Ben retracts his hand and looks up. Coach is glaring at him and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That racket came from here! Which one of you was stupid enough to bring a phone onto my court? Was it you, Ericson?
Coach steps up to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Please tell me it was you so I can kick you out of here!
Erik looks at Ben.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... It was...

nodes.title: The Dance Dilemma, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: With great power comes way too much responsibility...

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ZOE.
Before class, $ZOE and Sam are putting flyers up in the halls.
$ZOE takes down a poster advertising 'Basketball Tryouts' and puts up a poster of her own.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { Down with the old... In with the new... La tee da... {
Sam hands $ZOE some pieces of tape she's torn off from a roll.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's way too early in the mornng for you to be this happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I was humming too much again, wasn't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't be sorry. It's a good thing. It's nice to see you so chipper. I haven't see you happy since...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, since Howard left.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe he broke up with you again! The nerve of that guy!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'd strangle him, if I could.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not angry. And you don't have to be either. When Howard and I broke up, I learned that sometimes...

options.label: What seems right isn't always right.

nodes.text: Taylor leads $ZOE into the cafeteria, and $ZOE sees her friends on the cheerleading team laughing around a table.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So it's time we planned a cheerleading sleepover. Who's with me?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's that time of the year... We're going to be ranking which boys are the hottest.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Ugh, count me out.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hector's the best!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awww, babe... Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Ugh...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I have a new game we can play... Truth or make-out!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: So if you don't want to share your secrets, you can make-out with someone?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Count me in!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, me too!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I was talking about guys who `aren't` cheerleaders.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was talking about guys who [color=#3b78e2][i]aren't[/i][/color] cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Aww...
Taylor and $ZOE approach the table.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Taylor, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just showing $ZOE off as Social Chair.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh yeah, congratulations!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: So, you're totally going to let us plan the dances with you, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to let everyone plan the dances! I have a planning meeting after school today. You have to come!
$ZOE hands out her flyers.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay, paper! This is amazing! It's so glittery!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Amanda, I think she wants you to read the `words` on the poster...
nodes.text_bbcode: Amanda, I think she wants you to read the [color=#3b78e2][i]words[/i][/color] on the poster...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh right...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We're way interested in going to your meeting. I have some opinions on the dance theme.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great! I'm really hoping to hammer down a good date that will work for everyone...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Just don't schedule the dance on the `first Friday in December,` and you'll be fine.
nodes.text_bbcode: Just don't schedule the dance on the [color=#3b78e2][i]first Friday in December,[/i][/color] and you'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, why not then?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Remember Cheer Leader Days? They're workshops to help us improve our routines. The first one is on that Friday.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot, I forgot. Okay, I swear I'll make it work. See you at the meeting!
Taylor and $ZOE walk away from the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You might want to be careful what you promise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, you're a cheerleader, and you just swore to the other cheerleaders that you'd make their date work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you worried I'm...

nodes.title: The Dance Dilemma, Part 2
nodes.subtitle: Can $ZOE keep the school from tearing itself apart?

nodes.text: It's a new day at Twin Branches...
And $ZOE runs into Sam and Emily on her way to school.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, you two! How was swim practice?
Brutal. Coach K's insane now that the swim meet's less than a month away.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm used to training hard, but I swear, I can't move my right arm anymore.
Emily tries to stretch it out.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: OW. That's the last time I move today.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How's it going with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's... Okay.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That wonderful, huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had a planning meeting for the dance yesterday...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it was pretty awful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Awful? What happened? The crepe paper didn't match the balloons?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not exactly. It's not as bad as Sam is painting it out to be.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it was! You should have seen it...
$ZOE finds Emily and Kimi in the bathroom, talking. Kimi is fixing her hair.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE... What's up?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Emily... I wanted to talk to you about the dance.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Kimi and I are so excited!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I already have, like, the `perfect` ensemble. It's never too early to plan.
nodes.text_bbcode: I already have, like, the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] ensemble. It's never too early to plan.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: She's totally not kidding. Kimi's the girl who planned her outfit for the first day of school three months in advance!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: First impressions! What am I always telling you?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So, $ZOE, what do you want to tell us about the dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh no... What's wrong? It's not on the day of the swim meet, is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, it's on the second Saturday, the day of Ben's big basketball game.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What?! Ben doesn't have a basketball game that day... He would've told me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Apparently, Owen just turned in the permission slips last period, so he probably doesn't know yet...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: No, no, no! This can't be happening!
The look on Emily's face is so serious, $ZOE doesn't know how to react!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do I do?

options: Say it's not a big deal!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen.
It's the day before Thanksgiving. In the gym, Owen and the rest of the basketball team are practicing. As Owen gets in line for another layup, he whispers to Ben and Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why am I sweating this close to Thanksgiving? Shouldn't I be doing something a lot more American, like eating a deep-fried turkey wrapped in bacon stuffed inside a bigger turkey?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Heh. Or getting a bunch of frozen pizzas lined up for the greatest sports marathon day ever?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We get it, Spencer. You have a huge man-crush on football.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Football?! Pfft! I'm talking about wrestling, dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Is it that time of year again already?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You know it. Surf 'N' Turf Murph is going up against not one, not two, but `all three` of Tres Samurai! They're the world's only katana-wielding mariachi band!
nodes.text_bbcode: You know it. Surf 'N' Turf Murph is going up against not one, not two, but [color=#e23b3b][i]all three[/i][/color] of Tres Samurai! They're the world's only katana-wielding mariachi band!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm `actually` kind of interested in seeing that.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]actually[/i][/color] kind of interested in seeing that.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Cut the chatter! Or I'll run you so long, you'll give thanks for a glass of water!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, sir! Sorry, sir!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ericson! What's wrong with you? You weren't even talking!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I `was` listening! That makes me an accomplice to chatter!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] listening! That makes me an accomplice to chatter!

nodes.text: It's Ben's turn... He easily sinks his layup!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Smooth, Kale! That's what I like to see!
Owen is next in line for a layup...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: You going to make this one, Harris? Or do I have to see yet another ugly layup?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's just a layup. Easy as pumpkin pie.
Owen takes the ball, dribbles toward the hoop, and leaps high into the air for his layup...
But the ball sails way over the hoop, ricocheting off the top of the backboard and landing on the other side, out of bounds!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: That was the most hideous thing I've ever seen, even worse than my ex-wife after her fifth plastic surgery!
Owen returns to the back of the line.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: You really suck, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: One more thing to be thankful for.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Shut up. What are you doing for Thanksgiving, Kale?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My dad's out of town again so I'm going to have dinner at the Kesslers.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Again? They should start charging you for meals!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know how you can handle all that pressure.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, last time, Coach K called you a dumb party-loving dumbface.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's not what he said. And you guys always know how to boost my spirits. Maybe you should try out for cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't think anyone wants to see Spencer do a toe-touch.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about you, Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just a quiet, relaxing dinner with my grandma.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Pipe down! One more peep, and I `will` keep you here through all of tomorrow, holiday or not! That means no turkey! No cranberry sauce! No pumpkin pie!
nodes.text_bbcode: Pipe down! One more peep, and I [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] keep you here through all of tomorrow, holiday or not! That means no turkey! No cranberry sauce! No pumpkin pie!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! Not the pie! I swear I'll stop talking!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ericson! You weren't talking! Do you have a mental deficiency?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, sir! The conversation was so engaging, I couldn't remember if I had been talking or not!
Owen reaches the front of the layup line again...

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Harris! I'm tired of watching you miss layups! Everybody but you `on the baseline!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Harris! I'm tired of watching you miss layups! Everybody but you [color=#e23b3b][i]on the baseline![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The other players run to the baseline.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: All of you are going to run every time Harris here misses a layup!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No pressure! You can do this, Owen!
Owen dribbles toward the hoop for a layup and...
You are now playing as Ben...
Back at the Kessler house, Ben and the Kesslers are enjoying the turkey that Ben carved.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Kessler
nodes.text: I heard there's a big dance coming up! Are you two going?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Unfortunately, no. The dance got scheduled for the same day as our big game in Willow Glen.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: And I can't go because it's so far away. The game could run really late.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's right. We have a swim meet the following morning.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Emily and I are so busy now, I decided to make time for her.

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Kessler
nodes.text: How did you manage that, dear?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I talked it over with my coach, and he says it'd be okay if I missed a practice or two.
Coach Kessler nearly chokes on his food!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You will do no such thing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I won't?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Dad! You're not his coach!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm sorry, son, but that's not the thinking of a champion. If you skipped practices just to spend time with my daughter, I'd be `very` disappointed in you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry, son, but that's not the thinking of a champion. If you skipped practices just to spend time with my daughter, I'd be [color=#e23b3b][i]very[/i][/color] disappointed in you.

options.label: Then you'll have to be disappointed.
Who said anything about me being a champion?

nodes.text: Later, the team is warming up before the start of the game...
Ben hands his phone to Nick.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Do you think you could take some pics for me?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Lay up drill! Let's go!
Spencer goes first, easily laying the ball into the hoop.
You are now playing as Ben...
It's the start of the second half of Twin Branches' big basketball game against Willow Glen!
Before the game resumes, Ben brings the team in for a quick huddle!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're down by seventeen points, guys. It doesn't look good.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If we don't win this one, we'll have to win our last game to make Sectionals.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Wow. Awesome speech. Now I'm super motivated.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I wasn't finished!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Well hurry up!

Years of honed police training kick in, and Mal easily dodges his attacker, elbowing him in the chest.
He sweeps the intruder's feet out from under him, taking him down!
In one swift motion, he has the other guy's hands behind his back and is tying them down with a thick gold cord from a Christmas decoration.
The intruder falls to the floor, struggling against the wreath's constraining wires, but the wreath holds!
He's too quick for Mal, and Mal finds himself pushed back hard into a pile of gifts.
The intruder raises his weapon and hits him! Mal winces with the first blow, but it doesn't hurt as much as it should, and the smell of peppermint perfumes the air.
As the blows continue to land unabated, Mal hears snippets of what the intruder snarls at him, phrases like 'my house,' 'and on Christmas', and 'teach you to mess with Santa Claus'...
Or at least, that's what Mal `thinks` he hears...

nodes.text: All he knows for certain is that...
He has failed.

After the tryouts, Emily's walking home from school, when $ZOE pulls up alongside her.
Hi, Emily! Want a ride home?
Sure...
Emily gets into $ZOE's car.
What's up? Is everything okay?
I... I don't know.
Want to talk about it?
Sure... Ben just made the basketball team.
That's awesome!
Uh huh...
That's... Horrible?
No... It's not bad.
That's... Middle of the road?
Pretty much. I'm really happy for him.
Really? Because to be honest, you don't `seem` happy.
I know...
I'm just so used to being the busy one! Ben's always been there for me whenever I've had a spare moment. But now...
Were you supposed to hang out tonight?
No, not exactly. He's eating pizza with his new team, and I let him go because I didn't want to seem selfish.
Awww! Well, that's no big deal! It's just one night!
But one night can easily become two nights and two can become three and before you know it I'm sending him pics of what I look like so he doesn't forget my face!
I think you might be exaggerating the situation... Just a little bit.
Maybe...
Okay, I am. But we just got over all this drama about my friendship with Cameron. I don't want any more.
You'll be fine. I'm sure of it! Ben's the same way Howard was... He's not going to let anything get in the way of your relationship!
You think?
I know it.
$ZOE gives Emily a big smile as she pulls up to Emily's house.
Thanks...
Wow... I just dumped all my problems on you, and I have to get to bed soon. I'm so sorry.
Don't worry about it.
How are you though?
Good. Pretty good.
At least, that's what I keep saying...
It must be tough now without Howard.
Very... But I've kinda sorta done this part already, you know? Plus, there's--
$ZOE stops her sentence short.
There's what?
Nothing.
`Nothing,` eh? What's `nothing's` name? Is it Nate?
$ZOE smiles, but she keeps quiet.
I see. Not ready to share yet?
Not yet.
If you ever want to share... You know you can talk to me, right?
Yeah...
Emily leans across and hugs $ZOE.
Thanks for being there for me. And for the ride.
Anytime!
And that's your bonus scene!

After school, in the gym...
Jacob and Owen walk out after basketball practice.
That was tough! Coach is as hard as nails!
It's only because he believes in us.
He could stand to believe in us a little less... My legs could use the rest.
Ha ha...
Well, he's not going to let up anytime soon. We have that huge game in December.
What game is that?
Wilson High. If we're going to have any chance of making it to Sectionals, we'll have to beat them.
It'd be pretty awesome to see us move forward. We've been practicing so hard lately.
I haven't been this sore since I first started training for defense on the football field.
Yeah... I'm totally excited. This is the first year we've had a good enough team to go.
Ha ha...
They exit the gym, and Owen turns down a different hallway.
I'm going this way. I'll catch you later, Jacob!
Sure.
Owen walks towards his locker... And sees Paige standing there.
Did you work out a lot, or is 'Sweat' the stand-in scent for poor people?
What? Does it smell like 'too much hard work' for you?
Whatever.
What are you doing here, Paige?
I want to settle something with you.
Like what?
We got our grades back from Mr. Dean. He... He passed us.
Great. That's awesome. I'm glad hanging out with you wasn't a total waste of time.
What are you saying?
You didn't like spending time with me?
Uh...
Huh?
I can't say it was a complete picnic.
You got way more out of hanging out with `me` than I got hanging out with you.
Why's that?
Well, you kissed me...
Actually, `you` kissed me...
Whatever. You wanted it, so it counts.
It wasn't completely terrible.
Ugh! I don't even know why I bother talking to you about this!
You get upset too easily. Calm down. What did you want to say?
Nothing. I so absolutely didn't come over here to thank you for saving that stupid project.
Okay...
And for the record, that kiss meant nothing.
Great. It meant nothing to me either.
Great.
`Great.` I guess I'll see you around then.
Awesome.
Yeah.
Owen walks away, leaving Paige in the hallway.
What... What just happened?
As he walks out, he fails to notice Wes, hanging out in a shadow between the lockers at the wall.
Well, well, well...
And that's your bonus scene!

Meanwhile in the gym, the basketball team meets for practice.
Owen, Spencer, and Ben are playing a three-on-three scrimmage against Andy, Erik, and Jacob.
Ben dribbles down the court as Spencer and Owen keep ahead of him, trying to stay open.
Grr!
Huff... Huff...
Ben passes the ball to Spencer who goes in for a shot. It rebounds off the backboard, and Owen leaps up to get it...
...And his hands close around air!
No!
What?!
Jacob swipes the ball. Owen tries to go after him, but trips over himself! He brings Spencer down with him, and Ben has to leap over them to avoid being tripped.
Stop right there!
The basketball coach blows his whistle, stopping the game. The team gets into a line, and Coach walks up and down it, giving each guy a hard look.
All right, mama's boys! What's going on here?!
I've seen `girls` play better than you!
Well, Coach... The girls' basketball team `is` better than--
Erikson... Shut up.
You all make me sick! Especially you, Harris! You single-handedly took down your entire team! Are you a maggot or a man?!
He looks down imposingly on Owen. Owen gulps.
A man, uh, sir!
Then act like it! We need to win one more game in order to get to Sectionals, and there are only `two` games left to play!
If you play out there the way you're playing now, we're going to get slaughtered!
Now get out of my face. You get five minutes, and then you're running suicides!
The boys head to the water fountain, groaning. In line to grab a drink, Ben turns to Owen.
Hey man... What's going on? You kind of fell all over yourself back there.
Yeah, you suck more than usual!
I'm just off today.
Ben takes his turn at the water fountain, then Owen. They stand, resting against the wall.
So what's bugging you?
It's kind of about the dance...
Yeah, Emily's bummed about that. It sucks that I can't be there.
But hey, at least, I don't have to wear the monkey suit.
I say, who cares? So we're not invited. Whatever. It's just one dumb dance.
It's not going to be as great as seeing the tears of defeat in the other team's loser faces!
It's not really the dance. I don't care about going.
I just thought a friend was coming to see me play that Saturday. But she's got other plans.
It's too bad.
Yeah. Yeah, it is. But maybe I was reading too much into it, you know?
Not really. But you gotta put it out of your mind. You need to focus on basketball.
Of course...
`Basketball.`

Later that day, at Owen's place...
Grandma Betty, Owen, and Paige are sitting around the dinner table, holding hands.
And last, I'm glad to have people in my life whose hands I want to hold.
Couldn't have said it better myself! Let's eat!
As Grandma Betty starts serving up mountains of delicious stuffing, Owen talks quietly to Paige.
You okay?
Am I okay that my mother and Tad ditched us to go out and celebrate their nauseating engagement? No...
But?
But I'm glad you talked me into coming to this shack for turkey scraps.
Good.
Oh and don't stuff yourself with stuffing! I've got a pumpkin pie baking in the oven!
Oh my gosh! This food is amazing!
Kind of reminds you just how much we have to be thankful for.
You mean, like servants?
No, Paige, I meant--
Hee.
I see what you did there.
Gotcha.
And the three of them enjoy their feast for the evening.
And across town...
$ZOE sits down at the table with Sam and Aunt Cathy.
At their feet, Puddles happily drools over a bowl of food...
Woof. Woof.
Turkey anyone?
Yes, please!
Aunt Cathy starts serving portions of turkey and mashed potatoes and hands the plates to the girls.
Yum! I love how Thanksgiving revolves around food... That makes it the best holiday.
Yeah really!
So girls... What are you thankful for this time around?
Well, there have been a lot of sad things that have happened in the past month or so..
Breaking up with Howard... Turning all the school cliques against one another... Cutting the basketball team out of the Snow Ball...
And now, I guess, Owen is going out with Paige...
You don't know that...
I heard what I heard. But it's all these things that make it kind of hard to think about what I'm grateful for...
You have been through a lot.
Well, today is about setting those things aside. I'm still happy that I'm Social Chair...
But more importantly, I'm so grateful to have both of you in my life.
And Sam, what about you?
Well, since I haven't been dumped by a guy who's interested in another girl again, I'd call that a win.
I'm pretty grateful for that.
So there are no new guys in your life?
Good luck with that conversation, Aunt Cathy. I've been trying to find Sam a date for the Snow Ball for a couple weeks now.
Hey, I don't have to worry about things like that. Remember that fortune teller at Paige's Halloween carnival?
She said my love life wouldn't pick up until mid-February. I'm waiting until then.
She said that you'd find love near Valentine's Day? That's a little predictable.
That's fine with me. Why waste time looking now when Mr. Perfect is going to fall right in my lap later?
Well, that makes me sleep easier at night.
The girls laugh, and Puddles wags his tail.
Woof!
Well, girls, raise your mugs...
Sam and $ZOE lift their mugs of apple cider. Aunt Cathy does the same.
I am thankful for this wonderful Thanksgiving to have both of you in my house. Sam, you are my beautiful girl...
Aw, Mom...
And $ZOE, I'm so glad my sister let me keep you for now. I think of you as one of my own.
Aunt Cathy, that's so nice!
Cheers and a happy Thanksgiving!
And that's your bonus scene!

Far away in the Willow Glen gym, the whistle blows, and the game begins!
Right away, an opposing player gets the tip off, blows by Ben, and scores with an easy basket!
Hahaha! Ben Kale, right? I'm going to be in your face all day, Ben Kale!
You think you can stop me? I'm a perpetual motion machine. I can't be stopped!
Did this guy just use science to trash talk me? Is he... Like me? A nerd-athlete?
Ben catches a pass from Jacob at the top of the key, takes a shot, but has it swatted out of the air!
Oh no! That ball got blocked like an artery filled with cholesterol!
Going back the other way, the guy tormenting Ben pulls up for a three pointer... And sinks it!
I'm going to score so many points tonight! Watching our score is going to be like watching Fibonacci's sequence!
We'll see about that!
Ben passes the ball to Spencer and cuts to the hoop!
Spencer passes it back to him, Ben takes one dribble and--
The same guy steals the ball from him!
Whoop! What goes up, must come down! What comes down, must be mine!
All right. I officially hate this guy.
Kale! Stop turning the ball over!
Ben whispers under his breath.
Great idea.
On the next play, Ben gets the ball in the corner and manages to take a shot, but it bounces off the rim.
I thought you were supposed to be good!
What? No witty quip related to science? Ran out of facts?
You're so bad, you're like a conclusion without data!
You couldn't make a basket even if I gave you the formula for a perfect shot!
Oh, and your girlfriend's super ugly! Just a fact!
Grr!
Ben shoves the guy backward! Immediately the ref blows the whistle and gives Ben a technical foul!
Kale! You're coming out! Ericson get in there!
Hot dog! I'm in! This is going to really liven up my blog!
Ben spends the rest of the first half on the bench...
What is Coach Kessler going to think of me now...
When the buzzer sounds, the Willow Glen crowd chants 'Lars! Lars! Lars!'
The guy shoots Ben a wink as their team saunters off the court.
Ben looks at the scoreboard... It reads 32 - 15 in favor of Willow Glen.
Ouch.
Does this mean Twin Branches is going to lose?

Inside the gym, while Owen and $ZOE were outside...
The DJ puts on an uptempo song!
OMG! `Love is Like a Robot!` Come on, everyone, let's dance!
Not a bad song... But I'll leave the dancing to the preps.
Finally! A song worth moving to!
Sam and Kimi head out onto the dance floor and start dancing together!
Sam does a fancy move and bumps into someone behind her!
Excuse me.
Nick?! You're here?! Did the game end early?!
Yeah...
How'd it go?
Not a lot of happy pictures...
Oh... Poor guys.
Kimi smiles at Sam and dances away.
I haven't been here for very many songs, but this is like the first good song this DJ's played!
Ha! So true! You should have been here earlier!
An awkward moment passes between them...
This is... The part where I ask you to dance... But I'm not going to.
Wow. Smooth talker.
Oh, no! That totally came out wrong! I meant... I'm a really bad dancer!
Come on. You can't be that bad.
Well, you've seen me run. My dancing makes my running look graceful.
Yikes! If that's true, what are you doing on the `dance` floor?
To be honest, I was trying to take a shortcut to the punch bowl...
Sounds like the start of a bad country song.
{ Took a shortcut to the punch bowl... {
{ Took a punch from my ex... {
They share a laugh together, then...
Hey, Nick... I've been meaning to ask you... Are you okay?
Actually, I'm a little carsick from the crazy bus ride back, but--
That's not what I meant. I meant in general. In life.
It doesn't seem like you've ever talked to anyone about Sara...
And I know things weren't great between us at the time but I wanted to say that if you ever need to talk, you know where to find me.
Thanks...
So... Do you? Want to talk about it?
Not yet. I loved her, and that makes it hard.
If you ever need a shoulder to cry on...
It'll be yours.
You know, Sam, I've missed you.
Me?
Yeah, Sam, it's possible for someone to develop an emotional attachment toward you.
Some might call it friendship.
Ha...
Another awful slow song plays...
Sam and Nick groan at the same time and smile at each other.
So, you didn't really answer my question... How are you?
Honestly... Not good.
You sound like someone who could use a friend.
I could...
As the couples around them dance, Sam and Nick stay there, talking...
You are now playing as Ben...
On another part of the dance floor, Ben and Emily are dancing together...
I'm sorry that you guys lost... But I'm `so` happy you made it, Ben!
I'm happy I made it too! Any requests before the dance ends?
Yes! I don't want any drama! No discussions about our schedule, my dad, swimming, `or` basketball!
I just want to enjoy the company of my boyfriend.
I can get behind that.
Ben twirls Emily out and brings her back in, kissing her.
But, uh, I did promise your dad the next dance...
Hee hee! Who leads?
Him. Definitely him.
The two of them laugh and dance, happy to enjoy their night together...

Just as the side door flies open and $ZOE comes storming out!
Stupid! Boys! Grr!
$ZOE? Are you okay?
Owen?! What are you doing here?
The short answer? We got our butts kicked and we got them kicked `quickly.`
I'm sorry...
What's going on? Something wrong?
Nothing I want to talk about.
Make your choice!
Ask about it again.|Change the subject.
What do you do?
Score Up!
Yeah, if I owed someone `a gift` and `a confession`, I wouldn't want to talk about anything else either.
$ZOE laughs, remembering the deal they made that afternoon.
I needed that. Thanks.
She takes a deep, relaxing breath.
No problem.
Wait... Are you saying my embarrassing song wasn't enough to make up for scheduling the dance today?
Nope. You owed three things. That means you're two short.
Are you sure? Because it seems like something's wrong. You know you can always--
I `said` I didn't want to talk about it, Owen!
Are all guys just insensitive jerks who do whatever they feel like?!
Uh... I just wanted to make sure you were okay, but if you'd rather be alone...
$ZOE sighs.
No, I'm sorry. I'm just taking out my feelings on you. Please, stay.
Owen sits down on the steps. $ZOE joins him.
Maybe this is a bad time, but you do still owe me a gift and a confession...
Remember? You sang a song this afternoon to embarrass yourself?
$ZOE nods.
Right... A gift...
$ZOE looks around for something that might work as a gift for Owen.
Can I get you a gift card?
Same as with `the embarrassment,` it only really works if it's heartfelt.
Okay... I can do heartfelt.
Can we walk?
Sure...

$ZOE and Owen leave the area of the dance and walk out onto the track. The stars shine overhead.
My gift is something I'm going to tell you... Is that okay?
Depends on what you say.
Fair enough...
$ZOE looks up at the stars for a moment, then to Owen.
You know, when I first met you, I thought you were really cool.
Oh yeah? Must have been my `groovy` haircut.
Okay, now I'm `sure` that was the wrong impression. Seriously though, you seemed really cool.
What did I even say to you?
Um... I don't remember the exact words...
So how do you know I was being cool if you can't remember what I said?
Well, there's an easy way to find out. Role-playing!
$ZOE backs up a few steps, takes some deep breaths, and approaches Owen.
Hi, I'm $ZOE. Are you lost?
Owen grins.
I was lost... Until I found you.
That's it. See? You're pretty cool, right?
Hang on, you're breaking character! What do you say next?
Make your choice!
We're going to have a wonderful friendship.|Wow, most transfers are shy on their first day.
What do you say next?
I'm not most transfer students.
Oh really? Then what are you?
Score Up!
Super cool?
Of course!
Success! Coolness proven!
I'm pretty sure you veered off-script there.
Who? Me?
I'm pretty sure most people don't say that the first time they meet someone.
What if I added on that I'd go to great lengths to make sure you're okay before the State Championship game?
I guess that'd make sense... But only if I said I'd be there to cheer you up when you're worried about winning Social Chair!
That would have been a weird conversation to have...
Especially since I had no intention of playing football, and Social Chair wasn't even on your radar!
Well, I was right about us being wonderful friends.
Yeah. That's what we are. Friends.
Yeah...
Wait... Was Owen thinking we were something more?
They round a corner of the track...
So... I'm cool. Was that all you wanted to tell me?
Not all... I was just thinking about the past. Like how you confronted Ken about what you'd done... How you'd hurt him...
I don't remember if I said anything about it then, but that was really...
Make your choice!
Brave.|Impressive.
That was really...
Impressive? What's impressive about putting a guy in the hospital?
Nothing. But you made a mistake. Everyone makes them.
But not everyone can face them the way you did. And that impressed me.
I didn't talk to Ken to make myself look good, $ZOE.
I know! That's not what I'm saying.
And it wasn't about you either!
I'm not saying it was! I'm just saying that it had that effect, whether it was intended or not.
Oh...
Anyway...
How so? I put the guy in the hospital. There isn't anything brave about that.
You made a mistake. Everyone makes them.
Score Up!
But not everyone has the courage to face up to their mistakes, especially big ones like that.
I was... I was so proud to be your friend then.
It wasn't easy... I don't think I could have done it without you there.
I was prouder of you when you dealt with his brother.
There aren't many guys who'd show as much leniency as you did, knowing how he'd vandalized your stuff.
He was angry with me. And with good reason. He just didn't express it in the right way...
Besides, he was just a kid. What else was I going to do?
Hee... Did you attend some kind of compliment deflection school or something?
Well, tonight I lost a big basketball game...
And then I got a bunch of compliments from a pretty girl on a pretty night.
Suddenly, the loss doesn't hurt quite as deep. So, yeah, that was an `amazing` gift.
Did... Did you just call me pretty?
Uh... I called the `night` pretty. Let's, uh, let's head back.
Sure.
They walk together in silence for a while...
Soon, the sounds of the dance can be heard as they reach the same steps from before. Owen leans on the railing.
He seems deep in thought...
Someone said today that it's never hard to convince the heart to go after what it already wants.
What made you think of that?
Good company, I think.
Awww!
So... I've seen `an embarrassment` and I've received `a gift`... Will I be hearing `a confession` tonight too?
$ZOE takes a deep breath.
Well... I don't know if you know this, but I went with Nate to the dance tonight...
No, no I didn't. Is that your confession, because we all make bad decisions.
That's not my confession.
Oh...
Incidentally, it... It didn't go very well.
So... `That's` your confession, because I'll have to admit that's not very surpris--
No, no, that's not it either. Please, just let me get through this.
It's been a long night.
Sure.
What I want to say is that I only came here with Nate because I know he likes me...
And because he asked me...
But the guy I like, the guy I wanted to ask me... He didn't.
Wow. That's... That's a pretty good confession.
Almost. That wasn't quite it either. What I want to confess is this...
Paige appears from around the corner.
Owen! There you are! Just because your team lost doesn't mean you have to associate with other losers!
Great. Right on cue.
$ZOE...
Come on already! I've decided to take you away from this dumpy dance and treat you to a `real` party!
I know you don't deserve it, but I'm in a good mood.
I'm sorry, $ZOE. Paige came to my game. I... I should go with her.
I know. I get it...
Owen turns and heads off with Paige, leaving $ZOE by herself.
She sits back down on the steps... And cries.

Here's my chance to give Owen his gift! A bunch of heartfelt compliments!
Face it, Owen. You're...

Kind-hearted!|A good person!|Strong!

Really? That's all you can think of to compliment me? I play football?
That's not it! I mean, you also... Play basketball.
Wow. If this is heartfelt, I'd hate to see lackadaisical.
I'm sorry... I'm just emotionally drained.
Yeah, well, let's go back.
They walk back toward the gym, neither of them saying a word.
$ZOE gets the undeniable feeling that she's blown it, a feeling confirmed by the sad look on Owen's face.
You're kind-hearted and you're good and you're strong!
Okay! Enough! Enough! I can't deflect all this kindness!
Score Up!
So... Was this a good enough gift?
You are now playing as $ZOE...
In the Twin Branches gym, everyone is excited!
Near the entrance...
Look at all these decorations! I feel like a movie star!
I love these white snowflake danglies!
What do you think, Manda-Panda?
I didn't bring my snow boots!
It's not real snow...
Is it a real gym?
Uh...
Emily and Kimi are returning from the restroom...
Can you believe how many couples there are?
I have a feeling some of them are just couples for tonight only...
Ryan walks by, his arm around Nicole.
And that's why I asked you. After Maria, you're the prettiest cheerleader.
Awww! I always thought I was third or fourth!
No way! Not with that shiny red hair! It's like a sports car on your head!
Let's go make out!
At least, I hope it's just for tonight. 'Cause gross.
I miss Ben.
Have you heard anything from him?
Emily checks her phone...
%s %s %s %s %s
Hee! He's coming!
At a table in the corner...
Surprisingly few aliens at the dance. I was expecting more costumes.
Yeah, seriously. No tentacles? No triple-eyed Martians? What's the point?
Ashley approaches the guys.
Want to dance, Dex?
Ub. Urp. Well!
Come on. Isn't this outer-space theme cool?!
Uh... Yes?
Ashley leads Dex away from the table...
Oh yeah, that's the point.
Denni and Colt pose for a photo while Autumn adjusts the camera...
You two have such a great energy! It's totally palpable and just `so` easy to photograph.
If only we could take a picture where both of us smile, instead of just me.
Hey, I smile! I'm smiling right now!
That's not a real smile!
I think he means he's smiling on the inside.
Yeah, what she said. I've got a big grin on the inside. The same grin I have every time I have to cram my feet into these fancy-pants shoes.
And I know I said `fancy-pants shoes.` Deal with it, Princess.
Okay, okay. If you take a good picture, we can leave the dance early and make out in the parking lot. How does that sound?
Does this face answer your question?
Over near the DJ, the swim team guys are hanging out...
So many hotties!
So many future Lee's girlfriends!
I just figured out your problem.
Who said we had a problem?
Both single. No date.
You're in the same boat, dude!
But that's just it, you try too hard.
The trick to getting a girl is to stop talking about it.
Cameron leaves the two of them there and immediately starts dancing with a beautiful girl.
Sometimes I hate that guy.
Taylor comes over to $ZOE and Sam's table. Emily and Kimi arrive at the same time.
Perfect job, Social Chair! I couldn't have done it better myself!
Ha! Never mind! I could have... But I'm, like, the only person who can do better than perfect!
Thanks, Taylor... Kind of.
Taylor wanders off to find Brendan. The girls are quiet. Then...
So much for Girls' Night... I miss dancing.
Hey, $ZOE, you're the only one of us with a date. Where's Nate?
He's getting some drinks.
Ooh! How come I didn't know that? It's gossip time!
What?
The moment your date leaves for drinks is the `perfect` time to get a mid-date scoop!
Uh-oh... Watch yourself. Kimi gets a little frenzied when gossip's near.
You seem sad! Is it because of Nate? Has he been boring? Did he beat someone up?
Ohmygosh! Did he try to get frisky with you?!
No! He didn't `get frisky` with me! How I'm feeling has nothing to do with Nate.
Suuuure.
Really, it's not about Nate. It's about Owen.
I'm just feeling--
Jealous? Of Paige?
I was going to say...
Make your choice!
Guilty.|Confused.
I was going to say...
Confused? Because you have a crush on Owen? Squee!
I didn't say that!
Because you have a crush on Nate?! Eeep!
You're putting words in my mouth!
Ohmygosh! Because you have a crush on both of them?! Aaaaah!
Have you lost your mind, Kimi?!
You haven't denied it, it must be true!
I'm just confused about what I'm feeling. I like Owen, but he's a friend, and he and Paige seem close.
And I like Nate, but I'm not sure about him.
This is just like a romance novel! If only one of them was a werewolf and one of them was a vampire!
I'm totally Team Owen!
Ooh. That sounds juicy!
It's not. It's actually pretty simple. I made Owen a promise, and I couldn't keep it.
I know it's not the biggest deal in the world. I know circumstances give me an excuse.
But I feel bad about it, and when I feel bad about something, it usually means I've done something wrong.
Or that you're too nice...
Maybe...
Well, you could always try to make it up to him.
I've already been working on that. You might remember my singing debut earlier today.
Don't remind us. My ears haven't stopped bleeding.
You know what? It sounds to me like you really care about him.
Score Up!
Yeah, that's probably the best way to put my feelings.
Nate comes up to the table, carefully balancing drinks for all the girls.
Ladies...
Thanks, Nate.
He holds $ZOE's gaze as he hands her a drink. His brow furrows.
You okay?
Yeah, I'm fine.
Uh huh. I know what 'I'm fine' means.
He holds out his hand for her.
Dance?
Sure.
She takes his hand, and the two of them walk out onto the dance floor. Nate holds $ZOE close, and they dance together.
So... Want to tell me what's got the always-happy, always-cheery $ZOE down?
It's complicated.
Heh. Let me guess... Howard's gone. Owen's at a basketball game because you scheduled the dance today...
Paige is probably there cheering him on. And you're here, stuck with me.
Make your choice!
Don't be hard on yourself.|'Stuck' isn't the word I'd use.
What do you say?
In fact, I'd just omit it completely...
I'm here, with you.
I like that a lot better.
Score Up!
I thought you might.
I wasn't being hard on myself at all. I was just expressing what `you` were feeling.
What do you mean?
I know I'm a pretty good catch. I'm the quarterback, I look good tonight, and I have never used 'body spray'.
That last one's a huge plus.
Joking aside, when are you going to see me as more than a backup plan?
You're not my backup, Nate.
I'm not even going to ask, but we both know if Owen were around, you'd have gone to the dance with him.
$ZOE doesn't say anything.
Uh huh.
Anyway, did I get that right? The many reasons for $ZOE's sadness?
I'm just so confused, Nate...
Howard, Owen, Paige, Social Chair, and--
And me?
Yeah, and you. I'm completely mixed up right now...
Nate holds $ZOE closer and brings his voice down low.
I want to tell you a secret. I've never really told anyone this, but I think it might help.
Oh, you don't have to... Are you sure?
I am...
A long time ago, my dad arranged for a college football scout to come over to our estate.
Really? When?
I was in middle school at the time, but if high school guys can play pro sports, why not?
Anyway, my dad kept telling me how important it was that I impress this guy.
The more he hyped it, the more nervous I got.
I can imagine!
The day arrived, and all my attention was on this tryout...
Then my mom came home and announced that she was pregnant with my baby sister.
No way! I didn't know you had a sister!
Yup. She's adorable.
So... What happened?
This is the part that's hard to tell you about...
I couldn't handle the news. I couldn't handle two big events at the same time.
And... And I fainted.
No!
Yup. I fell over right there in the kitchen, knocked my head on the counter, and my parents had to drive me to the hospital!
Ohmygosh!
It was crazy. I've never told anyone because it's hard to be the leader of the football team when you're also the guy who faints.
Hee! It'll be our secret. But wait... What happened with the scout?
He's still around.
$ZOE, I'm a tough guy.
But things can get overwhelming even for guys like me. What I'm saying... It's okay to be overwhelmed when you've got a lot going on.
Thanks, Nate.
So... Did you end up with a scar from where you hit your head?
Yeah, check it out.
Nate pulls back and lifts up part of his hair, exposing a scar along the side of his head. $ZOE touches it...
If anyone asks, dirtbike accident.
Hee. Much cooler.
Nate takes $ZOE's hand.
Maybe I can clarify one of your points of confusion... The point about me.
Their eyes meet.
I'm into you, $ZOE. I've been into you from day one.
She blushes, staring at their feet. Nate holds her chin and lifts her head back up, their eyes meeting again.
Nate...
You're who I want. You're beautiful, kind-hearted, and...
...And you make me want to be a better guy.
That's really `really` sweet, Nate.
But?
I wasn't going to say anything more. You've just been... Really sweet.
Nate leans forward to kiss $ZOE... And she doesn't move away.
Is this actually going to happen?
Nate gets closer...
I'm `so` glad I was patient...
Closer...
I'm `so` glad I asked you out...
Closer... $ZOE can feel the heat emanating from his lips.
I am `so` glad that Paige and Owen kissed.
Hurry!
Pull back!|Do nothing!
What do you do?
$ZOE does nothing as Nate's lips touch hers, kissing her!
For one moment, she feels like this is right...
Then, something clicks, and she pulls away!
What? What is it?
Wait... What does their kiss have to do with us?
$ZOE pulls back from Nate, not allowing him to kiss her.
Score Up!
Wait... What does their kiss have to do with us?
Just that if Owen and Paige hadn't kissed, you'd never--
How do you even `know` that they kissed?!
$ZOE gasps and separates herself from Nate's arms!
You `paid` Wes to tell me they hooked up, didn't you? You're the `interested party` he was talking about?
Uh, well, wait--
Hurry!
Slap Nate!
What do you do?
I can't believe I let you kiss me!
$ZOE moves her hand to slap Nate, but she stops herself!
You're not worth it, you jerk!
Or maybe deep down you know that what I did was necessary!
Grr!
$ZOE slaps Nate!
Score Up!
How could you, Nate?! How could you do that?!
$ZOE, wait!
She storms out of the gym!
Just a message that says...
%s %s %s %s %s

Nothing... I hope the basketball team is winning, at least.

Enjoy your dance! Get ready to run at our next practice!

What did you think of the game, Paige?
It was okay. You dove on the floor a lot.
Every time you did that, she said you had a nice--
There's a `thunk` underneath the table.
Uh... Diving form.
Heh. I'm sure.
Paige blushes.
Owen looks over and sees some commotion at the table where Emily, Sam, Kimi, and Nate are...
Excuse me...
He walks over...
What's up?
No one's seen $ZOE. Have you?
What?
I messed up and then she fled out the door! No one's seen her!
She probably went `home,` Nate!
What'd you do?
I... I might have accidentally told her how I paid Wes to tell her that you and Paige kissed!
Why did you do that?! How did you even know that?!
Owen clenches his left hand!
Go `left!` Left fist! This must be what Madame Fortuna was referring to!
Owen clocks Nate across the face with his left hand! Nate sprawls across the floor!
After a year-long stint in Boot Camp, at Madame Fortuna's parlor...
Owen storms in!
I've been expecting you, though I thought you might be here sooner!
Owen's face is damaged by sun, his clothes ragged, his body scarred.
Do you have any idea of the kind of torment I've been through!
Yes, as a matter of fact I know exactly what you've been through.
Go left, you said! Go left! Nothing's gone right since I started going left.
Ha! That's funny!
Grr!
Funny... To some of us anyway.
The problem is simple, Owen. You blew your moment to go left a long time ago.
What? When?
The moment you got off the bus...
And Owen remembers that feeling, the one he ignored, and his whole body sinks.
He knows, without a doubt, that...
Owen follows his instincts and heads off to the left, around the other side of the gym.
This must be the choice Madame Fortuna was referring to at the Halloween Dance!

I guess I'm not the only one who's getting his life together.

Don't talk like you know better.
You're just a kid.

I got to go. Merry Christmas.
I hope Natara and I will see you in our neck of the woods soon.
And bring Denni. I'm sure there's a college or two near San Francisco she'd be interested in.

nodes.text: Ugh, I should `know` this...

nodes.text: The snow in front of you sizzles and melts...
Revealing Simon and Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: At last! We have reached you!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But it looks like we've still got a long way to go...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That is not all. I managed to reach a window... The snow isn't just in here. It's outside as well!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The doors and windows are all blocked!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Then we're stuck in here...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But at least it'll only be a matter of time before one of the professors comes looking for us.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: With a disturbance this big, I'm sure someone will notice soon. We'll just have to sit tight until help comes.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Just great! Simon, I can't believe you've gotten us into this mess. Why did you mess around with duplicating that snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I didn't want to give Arinna a gift unless I had something for you! It would just be rude!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, `that` would be rude... But burying us alive in snow is, what, proper etiquette?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] would be rude... But burying us alive in snow is, what, proper etiquette?

nodes.text: A gust of ice-cold wind suddenly blasts through the room.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That was weird... There aren't any windows open... Where did that wind come from?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh no! The... The Rig'Rhallan candles! They've been extinguished!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um... So?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You don't understand! Rig'Rhallan is not some frivolous festivity!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is a time of sacrifice to keep evil away!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, come on... Do you really think some big Riggy-Rooly beast is going to come charging in here just because the candles went out?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I... I suppose it is just a legend...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, it's probably just a story that only a 'Onceling' or whatever would be scared of, right?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, perhaps you are correct. There is probably nothing to fear. It is, I suppose, what you would call a superstition.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, besides, we've got a bigger problem...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Which is that we're completely snowed in!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is quite cold here with all of this snow.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey, I've got an idea. Maybe the snow didn't reach my room. At least it would be warm there...
Another burst of wind blows through the room, and the door to your room is swept open!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, that was a little weird...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: At least it appears there is no snow inside $CADY's room...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: One moment! Let me take my present...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, are you seriously going to bring a snow globe with us? This is the `one` room without snow.
nodes.text_bbcode: Arinna, are you seriously going to bring a snow globe with us? This is the [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] room without snow.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I will be careful! I do not want to confuse it with the other duplicates. This one is special because Simon gave it to me.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Aw...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, fine, fine! Just don't let any more snow fall!
You and your friends head into your dark bedroom.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, how about getting the lights on in here?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, just a sec...
Suddenly, everything goes dark!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, is there a blackout or something?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: No, this is way darker than normal... I can't see a thing!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I heard something!
You squint at the shadows... And something moves!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I... I just saw someone!
You feel a shift in the room, and when the lights come back on...
The room has changed! Your familiar bedroom is gone, and the room has become an ice skating rink!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Um, $CADY, is now really the time to be changing your room's appearance?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: I didn't do this! Arinna, did you just change my room?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: No! Of course not!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Only a student assigned to this room would be able to alter it... Cady, are you sure you didn't think of this... Place?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Believe me, I have no idea where this is. But I did see someone... A shadow...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Are you sure you're not imagining things?

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Positive. I... Look!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What the...? Did you see her?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Something strange is happening. Rig'Rhalla, the beast of dread, is taunting us!
Snow begins to softly fall...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, did you shake your snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I have not moved it! This is most strange...
You hear a sound like soft footsteps and imprints begin appearing in the snow on the ground!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Do you see that? It's...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I believe they are footprints!
As you watch, delicate, small footprints appear one at a time in the snow in front of you!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Okay, this is definitely creepy.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I do not understand... Rig'Rhalla has tentacles, not feet...
The falling snow swirls in a chilling gust of wind. The footprints suddenly stop... And turn.
The lights flicker and then...

nodes.speaker: Lorenna
nodes.text: You...
The ghostly and shadowy form of a young girl stands before you. She's about your age, with dark black tears tracked down her face.
A small floating `ball of flame` appears in the palm of your hand!
nodes.text_bbcode: A small floating [b]ball of flame[/b] appears in the palm of your hand!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Nice!
You hurl the ball of flame at the snow packed around you. The snow sizzles and melts...
Revealing Simon and Arinna!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: A most impressive display of magic!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, that was pretty sweet, $CADY.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Heh. Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: But it looks like we've still got a long way to go...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: That is not all. I managed to reach a window... The snow isn't just in here. It's outside as well!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: The doors and windows are all blocked!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Then we're stuck in here...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: But at least it'll only be a matter of time before one of the professors comes looking for us.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: With a disturbance this big, I'm sure someone will notice soon. We'll just have to sit tight until help comes.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Just great! Simon, I can't believe you've gotten us into this mess. Why did you mess around with duplicating that snow globe?

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I didn't want to give Arinna a gift unless I had something for you! It would just be rude!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, `that` would be rude... But burying us alive in snow is, what, proper etiquette?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] would be rude... But burying us alive in snow is, what, proper etiquette?

nodes.text: A gust of ice-cold wind suddenly blasts through the room.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: That was weird... There aren't any windows open... Where did that wind come from?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Oh no! The... The Rig'Rhallan candles! They've been extinguished!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Um... So?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: You don't understand! Rig'Rhallan is not some frivolous festivity!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is a time of sacrifice to keep evil away!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Oh, come on... Do you really think some big Riggy-Rooly beast is going to come charging in here just because the candles went out?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: I... I suppose it is just a legend...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Yeah, it's probably just a story that only a 'Onceling' or whatever would be scared of, right?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Yes, perhaps you are correct. There is probably nothing to fear. It is, I suppose, what you would call a superstition.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Yeah, besides, we've got a bigger problem...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Which is that we're completely snowed in!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: It is quite cold here with all of this snow.

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Hey, I've got an idea. Maybe the snow didn't reach my room. At least it would be warm there...
Another burst of wind blows through the room, and the door to your room is swept open!

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Uh, that was a little weird...

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: At least it appears there is no snow inside $CADY's room...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: One moment! Let me take my present...

The ghostly and shadowy form of a young girl stands before you. She's about your age, with dark black tears tracked down her face.
There is a small disturbance in the air over your palm, as if the air itself had grown thick, and then `NOTHING...`

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Come on!
Simon continues to struggle!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Simon!
The ghost turns away from Simon and looks at Arinna again.
Or more specifically, what Arinna is holding!

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: My snow globe! It is somehow still intact...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Arinna
nodes.text: Perhaps because it was the original snow globe and not a duplicate...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Wait a second... This place... It's exactly like the inside of the snow globe!

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Simon, I'm starting to think there was more magic on that snow globe than you realized...

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: I'm a secure enough guy to admit that you may be right...

nodes.speaker: Cady
nodes.text: Arinna, give me your snow globe! I've got an idea!
Arinna hands you the snow globe, and the ghost's eyes snap to you.
A small floating `ball of flame` appears in the palm of your hand!

You hurl the ball of flame at the girl! She jumps back before it hits her, releasing Simon.

nodes.speaker: Simon
nodes.text: Thanks, $CADY.

nodes.text: Simon! Are you okay?
Arinna runs to Simon, and the ghost's blank, dark eyes follow her...

nodes.text: The guys slap Howard on the back.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: Back in the day, we were an unstoppable team. Remember how it used to be?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Couldn't forget. Those were good times.
$USR slaps Howard on the back.

nodes.speaker: Flash
nodes.text: The best.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: How would you like to play?

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The basketball team!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Your decision to join steak?! Are you some kind of weirdo?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ben! What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I meant basketball! My decision to join the basketball team!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Um, about that? Could you repeat some of what you said?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude! What were you doing in the bleachers? Painting your doll collection?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You mean... While you and Owen were going over the first rule of sports club?!
Coach blows his whistle at Spencer and Ben.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Keep it down and pay attention!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Boxing out is when I turn my back to the offensive player?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right on the money! Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Boxing out is when I turn my back to the offensive player?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Right on the money! Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Nice job on your decision-making.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It didn't feel like a 'nice job.' Did you see the look on Autumn's face? She was so sad!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, but that's how it goes. You made the best choice. Besides, that club has to know that they can't just go around changing rules.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Unless you want to get hit by another slushie in the hall...
She holds out her shoes for him to see.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've already been hit once today...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You saved me from having to change my shirt too...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, you didn't totally blow that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: High praise, coming from you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... Are you still upset?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I'm having an awesome time with your witchy mother and her jerky boyfriend!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: No more weird dancing near the bus! It's distracting!
Owen follows and does the same!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yes! That's what I'm talking about!
It's Ben's turn! He goes up and smoothly completes a reverse layup!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, Kale! Nice! Now that's focused!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I came to win!
Despite their mistakes, Twin Branches manages to claw its way back in the fourth quarter.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: In conclusion, you guys played hard, and that's all I can ask of you!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
